Ama, baŋhina waa bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge maa, ba ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna. 13Banna chaasi gunla, nɛr maa waa ɔɔ kaa wer zum banla n na chaasi ni bɔsɔna ani banla ge n na wii di ra chɛɛhgi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba kɔɔi la faa ra la bɔɔnɛɛrɛ werge maa.

Title: ƐZRA 4
Content:
Kɔraawiizi Dia kuaraa ma tɔɔrɔɔ wia
1Juda ni Bɛnjamin dizi dɔma n wa nuuwɛ lugɔ ba bittɔɔ ra ma Dia ba tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, 2ba faa ba Zɛrubabɛl ni ba domeezi nabɔnzi be di wa ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya hiini ia di ma Kɔraawiizi Dia la, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa maa ra jaamuubuu, di ra lizi mbusuzi ra tɛu gunla iinna ɛɛ la, di haŋ lii saŋa la Koorizeŋ Ɛsahadɔn n na di kora Asiiria hɛri la. Waabuu ba yaa ni ɛŋ.”
3Ka Zɛrubabɛl ni Jesua ani domeezi nabɔnzi la maa ŋɔ, “Yaa ni ia wàá wer kpau di ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ. Yaa bɛnnɛ niŋ mau tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa Izrɛl hina n na hum la, gunla Pɛsia hɛri Koorizeŋ Sairus n ŋɔ yaa be la.”
4Denii a nɛra la n soge bar baa la waa du baa bɔhuaih ni ɔnsii, lugɔ bá gilɛɛ wer ma a Dia. 5Denii ba faa kpa kebee kpa Pɛsia hɛri karchizenaa lugɔ bá chɔgi ba huma hiŋ, di haŋ lii Koorizeŋ Sairus kora dii saŋa maa guŋŋ Dariɔs ge kaa wa di Pɛsia kora, di ba haa waa gillɛ.
Ba dɔma n waa sɛɛ lugɔ bá bir ma Jɛrusalɛm wia
6Zɛgzis n wa faarɛɛ di kora, ba faa sɛbi tɛu, di kanni kara chug Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina.
7Denii Aatazɛgzis ge n kaa wa di yagboŋkora Pɛsia, Bislam, Mitrɛdaf, Tabiil ani ba balaa faa sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ a koori. Ba faa sɛbi a hɔnnɛ Aram hina mɔɔri biini, ba wa karmuu di bagli u zɛɛ tɛu.
8Rɛhum la n faa ɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma ni Simsai la n faa ɛɛ ba karchi, ge sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis, di kanni kara chug Jɛrusalɛm hina, di ra ŋɔ,
9“Hɔnnaa lii Rɛhum n ɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma, Simsai n ɛɛ karchi ani ba dɔŋa hina seriya diire, hɛri nabɔnzi la maa n na binni nɛra ni, Pɛsia, Ɛrɛk, Babilɔn, Susa la n du Ɛlam hɛri hina 10ani banla maa Koorizeŋ Asurbanipal n lallɛɛ lii u hɛri, ba ga so bolzeŋ Samaria ni hɛssi aŋhina n du Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga la benii.”
11Hɔnnaabuu ba faa sɛbi.
“Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis, i hɔnnɛ keŋ, di lii i balaa la n du Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga la.
12Jara, yaa ŋɔ yá ŋɔ i benii i zum lugɔ Jus hina la n lii i be di wa so ɛŋ la, kaa biruu ba Jɛrusalɛm di waa ma dignikpega hina ni wichɔgɛɛra bol la. Ba bittɔɔ kuari u koŋlaa ni a zɛɛzi di ra ma.
13Jara, yaa ra nyiŋŋuu i zum lugɔ di ba haŋ wa bir ma a bolzeŋ ni u koŋlaa naa maa, ba wàá ka sɛɛ turgi lampoo gɛɛ di lizi hɛri kuna gɛɛ di kɛɛ kuna gba. A guŋ daŋ gil kebee wia du kpol tɛi. 14Awia, yaa n ɛɛ i balaa wia, yaa waa nyiŋŋi bá lɔi sɔkpassi. Awiarɛ yaa sɛbi hɔnnaa di ra tɛi, í zum wii la n du de, 15di gil ba pigzi hɛri naa kooribinaa faala wia hɔna biine di na. A daŋ gil i zum lugɔ a bolzeŋ naa hina ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa, koora ni ba hɛssi hina be, faala maa. Awiarɛ ba faa chɔguu la. 16Yaa ŋɔ ya ŋɔ i benii i zum lugɔ, di ba bittɔ ma a bolzeŋ naa ni u koŋlaa maa, hàá ka dɔɔ fɔŋŋa Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga ni.”
17Denii a koorizeŋ bir sɛbi hɔnnaa,
“Nabɔma Rɛhum, karchi Simsai ani ii dɔŋahina la maa n du bolzeŋ Samaria ni Muu Yufretis wiicholii yeŋa maa, ii hɔnnɛ keŋ. N na jaami ia.
18Hɔŋ la iiŋ sɛbɛɛ la, ba karmuubuu di biruu du n mɔɔri biini tɛŋ. 19N gillɔɔ ba pigzi di na lugɔ a bolzeŋ hina ɔɔ ra vɛɛ koora nuuzii, di dɔɔ dignikpega di ra koozi wia, di lii faala maa. 20Saŋa la, Jɛrusalɛm koora faa dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa, di ra di kora Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga hina maa ni, di faa gil ba ra turgi lampoo, di ra lizi hɛri kuna gɛɛ di kɛɛ kuna ra tɛɛ baa. 21Awia, ii gilɛɛ gil ba kaa bir ma a bol, di miŋ lɛi wa tɛɛ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ. 22Ií ra du tau, di gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ wii naa. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii gil wii naa dɔŋ nyaŋŋi di wa chɔgi n kora diiribɔrɛi, màá ka na n kiparɛi?”
23Baŋ haŋ wa karmi Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis hɔŋ la tɛɛ nabɔma Rɛhum, karchi Simsai ani ba balaa la, ba hahzi di la a Jus hina hiŋ be, Jɛrusalɛm, di ga fir baa lugɔ ba gilɛɛ kaa ma a bolzeŋ.
24Denii ba gil Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ mai, guŋŋ di wa hel Pɛsia hɛri koorizeŋ la banna yir Dariɔs la kora dii binni anɛɛhiŋ biini.

Title: ƐZRA 5
Content:
1A keŋ saŋaa Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Hagai ni Ido naana Zɛkaria faa faari di ra ŋɔ wia, di ra du Jus hina la n du Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm la ni, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la sɔŋ biini. 2Denii Sɛɛltiɛl biibaal Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɔzadak biibaal Jesua kaa faari di ra ma Kɔraawiizi Dia, Jɛrusalɛm. A dɔgtɛɛzi banɛɛ naa faa du ba benii di ra hiini baa.
3A guŋ saŋa hiŋ, Tatɛnai la n faa ɛɛ Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga hɛri nabɔma, Sɛtar Bɔzɛnai ani ba balaa izi di ga pɛɛzi baa, “Anɛɛ n tɛɛ ia ŋmɛnɛɛ ŋɔ ii kaa kuari di ra ma Kɔraawiizi Dia naa, di kaa du u kuna maanɛi?” 4Di kaa pɛɛzi baa nɛra la n na ma a Dia sɔna. 5Ka Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la faa ra binni Jus hina sitɔɔra ninɛɛ. Awia, Pɛsia nabɔnzi faa waa gillɛ ba gil a Dia mai, ka ra kpaŋ gunla ban niŋ sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ Koorizeŋ Dariɔs, ú ge bir sɛbi tɛɛ baa, di ŋɔ u loobii.
6Hɔnnaabuu Tatɛnai la n faa ɛɛ Muu Yufretis wiicholii hɛri nabɔma, Sɛtar Bɔzɛnai ani ba babalaa nabɔnzi faa sɛbi tɛɛ Koorizeŋ Dariɔs.
7Wia la baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ labuu keŋ,
“Koorizeŋ Dariɔs, yaa bɔsɔna jaannɛ keŋ.
8Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu i zum lugɔ yaa la Juda hɛrii, di ga na gunla Jus hina n bittɛ kuari Kɔraawiizizeŋ Dia la di ra ma. Ba kpa bizenaa ni dollii di ra ma u koŋlaa. Ba aah siwiire di ra mau nɛnnɛ. A mai ge ra la manamanaŋ.
9Yaa pɛɛzi ba sitɔɔra lugɔ anɛɛ n tɛɛ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ ba bir ma Kɔraawiizi Dia naa, di ra du u kuna maa, 10di kaa pɛɛzi ba sitɔɔra sɔna, ya wer sɛbaa tɛi, í zum.
11Ba ŋɔ yaa be, ‘Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la ni hɛri maa balaarɛ. Yaa bir kuari u Dia la Izrɛl koorizeŋ bɛl n faa mawɛɛ biŋkpila maa n bɛrɛɛ, di ra mau. 12Ka yaa naabaala n faa fuuh Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la baaŋ wia, u faa kpa baabuu du Babilɔn Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza nonee biini, u faa lɔ baa laal di kpegli baa, di purgi u Dia hiŋ, ka lauri baa kaali Babilɔn hɛri.
13Ama, Babilɔn Koorizeŋ Sairus kora dii lugli bina biini, u faa tɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ lugɔ ba bir ma Kɔraawiizi Dia naa. 14U faa kaa kpa saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa kuna la maa Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza n faa paagɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia biini Jɛrusalɛm, di ga du u vuga dia, Babilɔn la tɛɛ baa.
Denii Koorizeŋ Sairus faa bir kpaa tɛɛ baal bɛl banna yir Sɛsbazar, unla uŋ lizɛɛ u ɛɛ Juda hɛri nabɔma la, 15di faa ŋɔ u be lugɔ u bir kpa a kuna di ga du Kɔraawiizi Dia la, Jɛrusalɛm biini, di bir kuari Kɔraawiizi Dia la di ma bɔr la baŋ faa mau la. 16Awia, Sɛsbazar bir kuari Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ zɛɛ chiŋŋi u bɔbinii la, Jɛrusalɛm biini. Di haŋ lii a hɔl hiŋ di wa lii zinaa, ba haa wɔɔ mawɛɛ tuŋ.’
17Jara, di a parii, gil ba pigzi koora faala wia hɔna biini, Babilɔn hɛri. Denii í zum, di wibii maanii Sairus faa sɛbi dau lugɔ bá bir ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ Jɛrusalɛm biini, ka i jaa gil ya nuu gunla hiŋ lauwɛ, a wia naa biini.”

Title: ƐZRA 6
Content:
Koorizeŋ Dariɔs widaulii wia
1Denii Koorizeŋ Dariɔs ŋɔ dí ba pigzi ba faala koora wia la baŋ sɛbɛɛ dau Babilɔn hɛri la biini. 2Ba pigzi guŋŋ di wa na a guŋ hɔŋ, bolzeŋ la baŋ faa ra yir Ɛkbatana n du Mɛdi hɛri la. Kenne ba faa sɛbi u ni,
3“Koorizeŋ Sairus kora dii lugli bina biini, kenne u faa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm la wia,
Ií bir ma Kɔraawiizi Dia la n faa du Jɛrusalɛm la, di chiŋŋi u zɛɛbinii la ni, u ɛɛ mbusuzi lizibɔr. Ií mau, ú chiŋ laŋaa ɛɛ nogumzi tokkoahoro, ú wassi ge ɛɛ guŋ. 4Ií ɔɔ kpa bizenaa di ma solaa ahoro di hɔŋ dɔŋa ni, ka ɔɔ kpa dolli ge sag a ni u ge ɛɛ solkpaŋ. A kora kebeere ba kpa di turgi a Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ kim maa. 5Di kaa kpa saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa kuna la maa Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza n paawɛ lii Kɔraawiizi Dia n du Jɛrusalɛm, di kpaa ba Babilɔn la, ba kaa bir kpa a maa la Jɛrusalɛm, di ga du Kɔraawiizi Dia biini.”
Koorizeŋ Dariɔs n ŋɔ bá kaa faari a huma wia
6Denii Koorizeŋ Dariɔs bir sɛbi tɛɛ baa di ŋɔ,
“Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga nabɔma Tatɛnai, Sɛtar Bɔzɛnai ani ii balaa nabɔnzi la maa n du de la, ii gilɛɛ kaa wàá la Kɔraawiizi Dia la. 7Ií gilɛɛ ka kpa ii nuuzi di du a Dia mai wia biini. Ií gil a Jus hina nabɔma ni ba sitɔɔra bir ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ, di chiŋŋi u zɛɛbinii la ni.
8N ŋɔ n ŋɔ ii benii ii zum wii la iin niŋ ɛɛ tɛɛ a Jus hina nabɔnzi la n na ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ.
Kim la maa ban niŋ lɔ di lii Kɔraawiizi Dia mai hiŋ biini, daŋ lii Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga lampoo biini. Ií gil ba gilɛɛ wa mau di ra huhzi. 9Hɔpizii maa, ií ɔɔ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n du Jɛrusalɛm kuna la maa banna nyiŋŋi. Di naballii gɛɛ pebalaa gɛɛ peballii ba ra nyiŋŋi, ba kpa lizi mbusuzi di fuuh tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n du chiŋ, ií tɛɛ baa. Di huuti genii gɛɛ yazi gɛɛ siŋ gɛɛ nuurɛ, ba ra nyiŋŋi, 10bá ɔɔ wer lizi mbusuzi la n na par Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ, di ra suŋŋuu winanaa ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ koori ni n biibaala.
11Wii la n kaa jaau lugɔ, di nɛr maa haŋ wa bir n widaulii naa, bá pam u dia dola, di sɛɛh u nua bɛl di yaguu, di lalluu baŋ chiŋ. Ka ba purgi u dia ú birgi hul, dikuu a wichɔgii naa wia. 12Kɔraawiizi la n gillɛ u Sɔŋ du u biini la, waabuu niŋ chɔgi koori gɛɛ nɛr la maa n niŋ ŋɔ u bir n widaulii naa gɛɛ di chɔgi Kɔraawiizi Dia naa Jɛrusalɛm biini.
Mìŋ́ Koorizeŋ Dariɔsii dau guŋ. Ií hiŋuu nɛnnɛ.”
Kɔraawiizi Dia kpai du u nonee biini wia
13Koorizeŋ Dariɔs n jaa dau a keŋ widaulii la, denii Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga hɛri hina nabɔma Tatɛnai, Sɛtar Bɔzɛnai ani ba balaa la maa jaa hiŋ u nua la nɛnnɛ. 14Awia, Jus hina nabɔnzi la jaa wer na bɔr di ra ma a dia. Wiimaa ge kuari di ra tɛɛ baa, dikuu gunla Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Hagai ni Ido naana Zɛkaria n faa du baa bɔkpega wia. Ba jaa ma a Dia tuŋ, gunla Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la n ŋɔwɛɛ ani Pɛsia hɛri Koorizenaa Sairus, Dariɔs ani Aatazɛgzis n faa dauwɛ la. 15Ba faa ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hinnɛ tuŋ, baagu la banna yir Adar la hɔpizaa ahorohiŋ hɔl, Dariɔs kora dii binni anumbɛlhiŋ biini.
16Denii Izrɛl hina, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee ani banla maa baŋ faa laurɛɛ kaali Babilɔn, ka ba bir ba la, jaa di bahinaa ni bɔsɔna, dikuu baŋ kpa a Dia du Kɔraawiizi nonee wia. 17Baŋ faa ŋɔ ba kpa a Dia di du Kɔraawiizi nonee la, ba kpu nabala kalfa ni pebala kalfaanɛɛ ani peballi kalfaanaazuu, di kpaa lizi mbusu kuna tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Baŋ ŋɔ ba lizi ba wichɔgaa giltɛɛi mbusu ge, bubala fidaanɛɛrɛ ba kpa lizi mbusu. Bubal kpaŋ maa faa chi tɛɛ dee maa. 18Denii ba faa bargi Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la di du sugezi, bá ra hum ba huma Kɔraawiizi Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm la biini, gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ Moosis hɔŋ biini la.
Gillikaali dii wia
19Lugli baagu hɔpizaa fidaanaazuhiŋ hɔl, Izrɛl hina la baŋ faa laurɛɛ kaali la n bittɛ ba la, di Gillikaali. 20Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la maa sɔ bahinaa di lizi ba doŋa ha, di ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa Kɔraawiizi be. Levi dee kpu Gillikaali pebii, di lizi ba ni banla n bittɛ ba la ni ba lulla la n ɛɛ kizeehina la maa mbusu, tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. 21Denii Izrɛl hina la maa n bittɛ ba la, ni banla maa n gil widoŋa la banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ n na ɛɛ la, ka ra jaami Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la maa, di a Gillikaali hɔpizii diwee hiŋ. 22Hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛrɛ ba faa kpa di Paanuu La N Waa Yiisi Dɔɔwɛ Hɔpizizenaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la faa tɛɛ baabuu bɔsɔna werge, dikuu uŋ faa bir Asiiria koorizeŋ la bampirii, u faa hiini baa, ba wer ma Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la Dia wia.

Title: ƐZRA 7
Content:
Ɛzra Jɛrusalɛm balaa wia
1Annii maa n wa ɛɛwɛ tuŋ, di Aatazɛgzisii Pɛsia hɛri koorizeŋ. A saŋa di baal bɛl faa du de, ba ra yiruu Ɛzra. U mɛɛrɛ faa Sɛraaya, Sɛraaya ge mɛɛrɛ faa Azaria, Azaria ge mɛɛrɛ faa Hilkia, 2Hilkia ge mɛɛrɛ faa Salum, Salum ge mɛɛrɛ faa Zadɔk, Zadɔk ge mɛɛrɛ faa Ahitub, 3Ahitub ge mɛɛrɛ faa Amaria, Amaria ge mɛɛrɛ faa Azaria, Azaria ge mɛɛrɛ faa Mɛrayɔf, 4Mɛrayɔf ge mɛɛrɛ faa Zɛrahia, Zɛrahia ge mɛɛrɛ faa Uzi, Uzi ge mɛɛrɛ Bukki, 5Bukki ge mɛɛrɛ Abisua, Abisua ge mɛɛrɛ faa Finɛhas, Finɛhas ge mɛɛrɛ faa Ɛliaza, Ɛliaza ge mɛɛrɛ Aarɔn la n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma la, 6Ɛzra naa faa lii Babilɔnnɛ di ba. U faa ɛɛ baglii, di zum Moosis gbɔg la Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum n faa kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Moosis labuu nɛnnɛ. Kɔraawiizi faa du u benii di nɔŋŋuu. Awia, kunla maa uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi di ŋɔ koorizeŋ la be, a koori ɔɔ tɛubuu. 7Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis kora dii binni aniidaanɛɛhiŋ biini, Izrɛl hina baŋhina, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee, yiryitta, Kɔraawiizi Dia dominua guure ani u Dia balaa baŋhina ge izi ba Jɛrusalɛm.
8Ɛzra faa ba Jɛrusalɛmnɛ Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis kora dii binni aniidaanɛɛhiŋ, baaguzi anuehiŋ biini. 9A bina lugli baagu, lugli hɔpiziirɛ u faa lii Babilɔn, di faari u ŋmɛnɛɛ hiŋ volaa, di zuu Jɛrusalɛm a baagu anuehiŋ la lugli hɔpizii hɔl. Ɛzra faa wettoo vol a ŋmɛnɛɛ naa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi la uŋ faa ra hum la du u benii. 10Ɛzra faa aah siwiire ú helli Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la, di ra hiŋuu nɛnnɛ, di ra bagli Izrɛl hina a widaulaa ani a Gbɔgni maa.
Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis hɔŋ uŋ sɛbɛɛ tɛɛ Ɛzra wia
11Hɔnnaabuu Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis faa sɛbi tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra, n faa ɛɛ bagli, di zum Kɔraawiizi widaulaa ni u Gbɔgni ŋmɛnizi la uŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina la.
12“Mìŋ́ Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzisii sɛbi hɔnnaa di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra, n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la Gbɔg bagli.
N na jaamii.
13N dauwɔɔ lugɔ Izrɛl hinuu maa, Levi dee ani Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ maa n du n hɛri naa, di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ ú bir la Jɛrusalɛm, daŋ wer la. 14Awia, n ni n zɛɛsogna baniidaanɛɛ ra hum iabuu, ii la Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm di ga daani na gunla banna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la Gbɔg la n du i be la. 15Di kaa kpa jaa, di ii waa la, ii kpa saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa la n ni n zɛɛsogna n kpawɛɛ ra sunzi Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum, u Dia du Jɛrusalɛm la di ra la. 16Ií kaa kpa saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa la maa iin nawɛɛ lii Babilɔn hɛri ani sunzaazi la Izrɛl hina ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehina n lizɛɛ, dikuu Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la Dia n du Jɛrusalɛm biini la wia di ra la. 17Kebee gunla maa iiŋ wa nawɛɛ, ii ɛɛ ania di kpaa yau nabala, pebala, peballi, mia ani siŋ di kpaa lizi mbusuzi ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, u Dia mbusu lizibɔr la ni, Jɛrusalɛm biini. 18Denii i ni i lulla Jus hina jaa wer kpa saliŋhuŋŋa la ni saliŋ la maa n kawɛɛ di ɛɛ gunla maa iinna nyiŋŋi, á par Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la. 19Ií kpa kuna la maa baŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ia la ga tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, Jɛrusalɛm, bá kpaa di ra jaamuu u Dia biini. 20Di ii waa nyiŋŋi kunla maa lugɔ ii kpa ra hum Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la Dia la huma, ií lizuu lii n daama dauribɔr biini.
21Mìŋ́ Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis dauwɔɔ lugɔ Muu Yufretis wiicholii hɛri daama dauribɔra binna maa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la Gbɔg bagli, kunla maa unna nyiŋŋi di lii ii be nɛnnɛ, 22á hel lugɔ saliŋhuŋŋa kilozi kagboŋa ahoro ni kalfaanaazu, huuti ge kilozi kagboŋa fi, siŋ galɔnzi kalfaanue ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, ɔlivi nuu guŋ ani yazi gunla maga unna nyiŋŋi. 23Ií ra du tau nɛnnɛ, kunla maa Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ n na nyiŋŋi ii tɛɛ baa, bá kpa hum u Dia la huma, ií ɔɔ nyiŋŋaa tɛɛ baa, u baaŋ gilɛɛ waa fuuh n ni n biibaal maa ni. 24Ií gilɛɛ waa lɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina gɛɛ Levi dee gɛɛ u Dia yiryitta gɛɛ u Dia guure gɛɛ nɛr la maa n na hum u Dia la huma maa lampoo gɛɛ hɛri kuna gɛɛ kuŋkɛɛlaa.
25Ka hìŋ́ Ɛzra, kpa nunzuma la Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la n tɛi la, di lizi i nabɔnzi ni i sitɔɔra la n zum Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la Gbɔgni la, bá ra binni Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga nɛra maa ni, di ra di baa seriya, ka bagli banla maa ge n waa a Gbɔgni zummɛ. 26Nɛr la maa n ŋɔ wàá hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la Gbɔg gɛɛ n gbɔg, a dɛkkɔɔ bá tɛr u digni manaŋ, di kpuu gɛɛ di duŋŋuu gɛɛ di foozi u kuna maa gɛɛ di tɔu dia.”
Ɛzra n chɔli Kɔraawiizi wia
27Ɛzra ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa naabaala n faa ra hum la! Waabuu gillɛ a par koorizeŋ lugɔ u ra tɔgzi u Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm la. 28Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ koorizeŋ, u zɛɛsogna ani u nabɔnzi nɔŋŋiŋ, dikuu aŋ paruu wia. Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la n du n be wia, n dɔɔ bɔkpegaa di chaali Izrɛl hina sitɔɔra, n ni baa la.”

Title: ƐZRA 8
Content:
Domeezi sitɔɔra la ni Ɛzra n kaa bir ba wia
1Domeezi sitɔɔra la ni ba nɛra la baŋ faa sɛbi ba sɔna, ba ni mìŋ́ Ɛzra lii Babilɔn hɛri, saŋa la Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis n faa ra di kora labuu keŋ,
2Gɛsɔm, n lii Finɛhas naanna biini,
Daniɛl n lii Itama naanna biini, 3Sɛkania biibaal Hatus n lii Koori Deevid naanna biini.
Zɛkaria n lii Parɔs naanna biini. Baala kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fii, 150, faa jaa u ni di sɛbi ba sɔna.
4Zɛrahia biibaal Ɛliɛhɔnai n lii Pahaf Moab naanna biini. Baala kalfaanɛɛrɛ, 200, faa jaa u ni.
5Sɛkania, u mɛɛrɛ Jahaziɛl n lii Zattu naanna biini. Baala kalfaahoroo, 300, faa jaa u ni.
6Jonatan biibaal Ɛbɛd n lii Adin naanna biini. Baala tokkoanɛɛ ni fii, 50, faa jaa u ni.
7Atalia biibaal Jɛsaaya n lii Ɛlam dee biini. Baala tokkoahoro ni fii, 70, faa jaa u ni.
8Maikil biibaal Zɛbadia n lii Sɛfatia naanna biini. Baala tokkoanaazuu, 80, faa jaa u ge ni.
9Jɛhiɛl biibaal Obadia n lii Joab naanna biini. Baala kalfaanɛɛ ni fidiŋmantannaazii, 218, faa jaa u ni.
10Jɔsifia biibaal Sɛlɔmif n lii Bani naanna biini. Baala kalfa ni tokkoahoroo, 160, faa jaa u ge ni,
11Bɛbai naanna, u biibaal Zɛkaria ni baala tokko ni ŋmantannaazii, 28, faa jaa u ni.
12Hakatan biibaal Jɔhanan n lii Azgad naanna biini. Baala kalfa ni fii, 110, faa jaa u ni.
13Saŋa bɛllɛ Ɛlifɛlɛt, Jiwɛl ani Sɛmaaya n lii Adonikam naanna biini faa tɔ har ba. Baala tokkoahoroo, 60, faa jaa ba ni.
14Utai ni Zakur n lii Bigvai naanna biini. Baala tokkoahoro ni fii, 70, faa jaa ba ge ni.
Ɛzra n bittɛ ba Jɛrusalɛm wia
15Denii mìŋ́ Ɛzra chaali a nɛra maa, bɔr la baŋ peree nii ga de di pal ra la bol la banna yir Ahava, yaa n chɔɔwɛ hɔpizaa ahoro la. N na lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina du denii, ka Levi dee la waa, waa hoo. 16Denii n hum ŋɔ bá yir Levi dee sitɔɔra kabɛl, baabuu, Ɛliɛza, Ariɛl, Sɛmaaya, Ɛlnatan, Jarib, Ɛlnatan, Netan, Zɛkaria ani Mɛsulam, di kaa kpa ba nunzunna naa, Jɔyarib ni Ɛlnatan jaa. 17Denii n gil ba la Ido n faa ɛɛ Kasifia hina sitɔɔri be, di bagli baa gunla ban niŋ ŋɔ Ido ni u lulla la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna la n du Kasifia la be, bá ge lizi balaa bá waa hum Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini. 18Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi yaa la wia, ba tɛɛ yaabuu Sɛrɛbia, n faa zum huma nɛnnɛ, u lii Levi dee biini, di ɛɛ Mali naana, di kpa u niuna ni u biizi, ba maa ɛɛ baala fidiŋmantannaazi, 18. 19Denii ba kaa tɛɛ yaa Hasabia ni Jɛsaaya n lii Mɛrari naanna biini, ni u lulla, ba ge maa du baala tokko, 20. 20Di kaa kpa Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna kalfaanɛɛ ni tokko, 220, Koori Deevid ni u nabɔnzi n faa lizɛɛ bá ra hiini Levi dee la. Ba maa sɔnaa ba faa sɛbi du hɔŋ biini.
21Yaa n faa chaali bɔr la baŋ peree nii ga de di pal ra la Ahava la, mìŋ́ Ɛzra faa gil yaa vɔɔ nua, guŋ gil yaa siwii sɔɔni, yá suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi ú gil yaa ni yaa biizi ni yaa kundɔɔlaa wer vol a ŋmɛnɛɛ ni alaanfia. 22A faa ɛɛmbuu hiihzi werge maa lugɔ ń suŋŋi a koori, ú gil laallɔɔra ni zagtinna baŋhina tɔ yaa see, di guu yaa dɔma ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n faa kpa yardaa di ŋɔ a koori be lugɔ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa ni u fɔŋŋa du nɛr la maa n yarduu, di ra hiŋ u nua benii. Ka banla maa n wɔɔ yardɛɛ di vɛɛu la waa, u baaŋfuuih du ba ninɛɛ. 23Denii yaa faa vɔɔ nua di suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi lugɔ u guu yaa, u faa nuu yaa wiisuŋŋaa la.
24Denii n jaa lizi kizeehina sitɔɔra Sɛrɛbia, Hasabia ani ba lulla fi, ba ɛɛ baala fidibanɛɛ. 25N mɛgzi saliŋhuŋŋa, saliŋ ani kuna la maa a koorizeŋ, u zɛɛsogna, u karchizenaa ani Izrɛl hina maa n faa kɛɛwɛ ŋɔ ba kpa hiini Kɔraawiizi Dia huma la, di kpaa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la. 26N faa mɛgzi saliŋhuŋŋa tɔgzi n hel kilozi kagboŋa fidikabɛl ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, 19,500, saliŋhuŋŋa kuŋkuaraa tɔgzi n hel kilozi kalfaahoro, 300, saliŋ tɔgzi n hel kilozi kalfaahoro, 300, 27saliŋ tassazi tɔgzi n kaali kilozi ŋmantannaazi, 8, ani danyɛ tassanyɛgzaa anɛɛ baŋ vɔglɛɛ a tɔgzi hel saliŋ tassa, di tɛɛ baa.
28Denii n jaa ŋɔ ba be, “Ií ni kuna naa ɛɛ kunnanaananaarɛ Kɔraawiizi be. A saliŋhuŋŋa ni saliŋ naa ɛɛ ii sunzaarɛ iin tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la ii naabaala n faa ra hum la. 29Awia, ii ra binnaa di ra du a tau nɛnnɛ, guŋŋ di ra ba saŋa la iin niŋ mɛgzaa Kɔraawiizi kizeehina diini biine, Jɛrusalɛm, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina sitɔɔra, Levi dee ani Izrɛl hina domeezi nabɔnzi maa sibɔɔ.” 30Denii Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la faa lɛɛ a saliŋhuŋŋa, a saliŋ ani kunnanaananaa la baŋ mɛgzɛɛ la, di kpoglaa la Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la Dia, Jɛrusalɛm.
31Lugli baagu hiŋ hɔpizaa fidaanɛɛ hɔllɛ yaa lii bɔr la baŋ peree ba ra yiruu Ahava la, nii pal lii de di ra la Jɛrusalɛm la. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la faa du yaa benii, di guu yaa dɔma ni ŋmɛɛna ni, yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ hiŋ biini. 32Yaa n wa hel Jɛrusalɛm, yaa faa heezoore hɔpizaa ahoro.
33A hɔpizaa anaazuhiŋ hɔl la, yaa kpa la Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la Dia, di ga mɛgzi a saliŋhuŋŋa, a saliŋ ani kunnanaananaa la maa, di kpaa tɛɛ Yuria biibaal Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Mɛrɛmɔf. U ni Finɛhas biibaal Ɛliaza, Levi naana Jesua biibaal Jɔzabad ani Binui biibaal Noadia maanii faa du u be. 34A kuna maanii ba faa kur di mɛgzaa, di sɛbi a maa magazi dau hɔŋ biini, a guŋ saŋa hiŋ.
35Denii nɛra la maa baŋ faa laurɛɛ la Babilɔn, ka ba bir ba Jɛrusalɛm la, jaa lizi mbusuzi di fuuh a kuna tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la. Ba faa lizi nabala fidaanɛɛ, dikuu Izrɛl hina maa wia. Di kaa kpa pebala tokkoanaazu ni fidaanumbɛl, peballi ge tokkoahoro ni fidaaniidaanɛɛ. Denii ba kaa lizi buuna ge fidaanɛɛ, di lizi ba wichɔgaa mbusu tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Annii maa faa ɛɛ mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaare tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. 36Denii ba faa kpa koorizeŋ widaulaa hɔŋ la, tɛɛ Muu Yufretis wiicholii paga nabɔnzi ni ba nabɔntɔga, ba faa jaa ra hiini a nɛra ani Kɔraawiizi Dia huma la maa.

Title: ƐZRA 9
Content:
Ɛzra wiisuŋŋaa dikuu hɛrdumazi biihaana paai wia
1Baŋ wa ɛɛ annii maa tuŋ, Izrɛl hina sitɔɔra ba mìŋ́ Ɛzra be, di wa ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ani Levi dee la haa waa bahinaa bargɛɛ lii nɛra la baŋ soge dugli la ni ba wikuna ɛɛi biini, aabuu Keenan, Hitti, Pɛriz, Jɛbus, Ammɔn, Moab, Ijip ani Amɔri hina maa n na ɛɛ la. 2Ba paagi ba biihaanaa, di nyiŋŋi baŋhina ge tɛɛ ba biibaala. Awia, ba gillɔɔ nɛra la n ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa koozi nɛra la n bar baa la biini. Ba sitɔɔra ni ba nabɔnzi tɔ see, ba wibii nyaai naa biini.”
3Miŋ wa nuu wia naa, a chɔgi n biini werge maa, n lau n laala piili, di kpuzi n nyuhuna ni n taŋkulo huna ka so, n bɔra huah. 4Nɛra la maa n faa nuu Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la wiŋɔzi, ɔnsii lau baa ba bɔra ra sa la, ba jaa chaali bariŋ, dikuu banla baŋ faa laurɛɛ kaali Babilɔn la n bittɛ ba la wibii nyaai naa wia. Denii n faa so ni bɔhuaih, guŋŋ duana mbusu lizaa wa hel.
5Duana mbusu lizaa n wa helle, n izi di lii bɔr la miŋ faa soge ni bɔhuaih ni n laalipiilaa la, di giŋŋi, di yaa n nonee chiŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la, 6di suŋŋuu ŋɔ,
“N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, hiihzi lawimbuu werge maa, n ŋmaabi. Awia, màá wer lalli n nyuu i sibɔɔ. Yaa wichɔgaa nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ, yaa chɔgri ge ga chug baama. 7Di lii yaa naabaala saŋa la guŋŋ di wa lii zinaa, yaa bilchɔg kannɔɔ werge maa, dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia. Ba faa kpu yaa ni yaa koora ani i kizeehinaa, di lauri baŋhina birgi yoma, di paagi yaa kuna maa, yaa birgi sɔkpassi kuna hɛrdumazi koora nonee biine, alugɔ zinaa naa.
8Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, i suŋ yaa ninɛɛ saŋa kpurii naa biini, di gil yaa baŋhina ka, di du de ni bɔsɔna, Diinaniinanii naa biini. I lɛɛ yaabuu lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini, di gil yaa na bɔchaaŋ. 9Yaa faa ɛɛ yomaa, ka haa yaa gillɛ ha a tɔɔrɔɔ biini. I bagli yaabuu i nɔŋŋaa Pɛsia hina koorizenaa see, di tɛɛ yaa miibɔɔfalii. Yaa na ŋmɛnɛɛ di kaa wer ma hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizizeŋ Dia n faa puree la. Di gil yaa so Juda hɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm biine ni bɔsɔna.
10Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, ɛrɛɛ ya ŋɔ annii naa maa harɛi? Yaa gbɛlli i widaulaa la 11hiŋ ga i balaa n ɛɛ i dɔgtɛɛzi be tɛɛ yaa, saŋa la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, ‘Hɛri la iinna zuu ii dɔɔ la, ɛɛ hɛri la n doŋŋee, dikuu u nɛra wikuna wia. Dikuu ba wiɛɛlaa la miŋ kiiwe la wia, ba gillɔɔ ba wichɔgaa doŋa su a hɛri maa. 12Awia, ii gilɛɛ waa kpa ii biihaana di ra tɛɛ ba biibaala gɛɛ di waa kpa ba biihaana di ra tɛɛ ii biibaala. Ií gilɛɛ waa gil ii ni baa wàá ɛɛ dammunaa nuukpaŋ, ŋmɛnɛ maa. Guŋ daŋ gil ii dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, di di a hɛri kunnanaa guŋŋ di wa gilaa tɛɛ ii biizi, a ɛɛ ba kapɛttɛ kuna, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.’
13Wia naa n ɛɛ yaa be naa zɛɛ bɔttɛ lugɔ yaa wiɛɛlaa ani yaa bilchɔg n kannɛ werge wia, ka Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, haa yaa digna tɛrgɛɛ di hel gunla yaa wichɔgaa n makkɛ, ka gil yaa bannii ka, di haa du de. 14Awia, a dɛkkɔ yaa n niŋ kaa chɔgi i widaulaa, di kaa gil yaa ni banla n na ɛɛ i wikiilaa ra paagi dɔŋaa? Di yaa kaa ɛɛ guŋ, i baaŋ wàá fuuh yaa ni werge maa, í chɔgi yaa, bɛl maa wàá ka kaa? 15Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum, i wia deŋloore! Yaa banniibuu kawɛɛ zinaa. Yaabuu keŋ di chi i see, di di bilchɔg. Yaa bɛl maa waa dɛkkɛ lugɔ u chi i see gba.”

Title: ƐZRA 10
Content:
A nɛra n sɛɛ ba wichɔgaa chɔgri wia
1Ɛzra n faa ra suŋŋi wiizi, di ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa, ka faa ra wii di chol hɛri, Kɔraawiizi Dia la see la, Izrɛl baala ni haana ani bichalli kpila maa faa wa baruu. Ba ge gba maa faa ra wii werge. 2Denii Jɛhiɛl biibaal Sɛkania n ɛɛ Ɛlam domee hinuu naana faa ŋɔ Ɛzra be, “Yaa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la be, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa paagi hɛrdumazi nɛra la n bar yaa biihaanaa. Ka Izrɛl hina haa dɔɔ tamiirɛ. 3Awia, filaŋkeŋ, gil yaa ni Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la ɛɛ nuukpaŋ u see, yá duŋŋi a keŋ haana ni ba biizi, gunla hìŋ́ Ɛzra ani banla n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la widaulaa n niŋ bagli. Gil ya ɛɛ gunla u Gbɔg n na bagli. 4Ɛzra, izi chiŋ, a wii naa du i noneere. Yaa daŋ chi i har. Awia, dɔɔ bɔkpega, di ɛɛ guŋ.”
5Denii Ɛzra izi hɛɛhzi di du Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee ani Izrɛl hina maa, lugɔ bá hiŋ gunla baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la. Ba hɛɛhzi guŋ. 6Awia, Ɛzra jaa lii Kɔraawiizi Dia la see, di la Ɛliasib biibaal Jɛhɔhanan chɔɔribɔr. Uŋ faa du de la, waa diwee, waa nii ge nyɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u faa haa ra wiiu, dikuu banla baŋ laurɛɛ kaali Babilɔn, ka ba bir ba la wibii nyaai wia.
7Denii ba faa sii di bar Juda hɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm maa, lugɔ banla maa n bittɛ ba la, ba maa chaali Jɛrusalɛm, ka ŋɔ, dí 8nɛr la maa n niŋ vɛɛ chaalaa naa balaa hɔpizaa ahoro biini, u daŋ nyaa u kundɔɔlaa maa, gunla nabɔnzi n dauwɛ, ka bá lizuu lii banla n bittɛ ba la biini.
9A hɔpizaa ahoro biini, Juda ni Bɛnjamin dee baala maa chaali Jɛrusalɛm. A baaguzi kabɛlhiŋ, u hɔpizaa tokko hɔl, di a nɛra maa chaalɔɔ di so Kɔraawiizi Dia la bossee. Ba maa biine faa chɔgi werge maa, dikuu a wii n faa ɛɛ siaahmu ani dooŋ n faa ra ba werge wia. 10Denii Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra izi chi, di ŋɔ ba be, “Ii waa wibii dɔɔwɛ. Ií paagi hɛrdumazi biihaanaa. Guŋ kaa gil Izrɛl hina bilchɔg nyaŋŋi. 11Awia, filaŋkeŋ, ii sɛɛ ii wichɔgaa chɔgri, Kɔraawiizi la ii naabaala n faa ra hum la be, ka ra ɛɛ u kipar. Ií bargi iihinaa lii nɛra la n bar ia ani ii hɛrdumazi haana la be.”
12Denii a nɛra maa sɛɛ werge maa, di ŋɔ, “I di wibiire! Firaarɛ ya ɛɛ gunla hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la. 13Ka nɛra la n chaali bɔnnaa kpillɔɔ werge maa. A ge kaa ɛɛ yuu, awia, yaa wàá wer so baŋgia. A wii naa ge waa kaa ɛɛ hɔpizikpaŋ gɛɛ hɔpizaa anɛɛ wiɛɛlii, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa kpila maa jaa a wii naa biinii. 14Ií gil yaa nabɔnzi chi a nɛra maa naazi di ɛɛ wiimaa. Denii bá gil unla maa n dɔɔ hɛrduma haaŋ u bol lii ba, saŋa la baŋ dauwɛ, di kpa bol maa nabɔnzi ni sitɔɔra jaa, guŋŋ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la baaŋ wa sɔɔni yaa ni, dikuu a wii naa wia.” 15Asahɛl biibaal Jonatan ni Tikva biibaal Jazɛya bɛnnɛ faa di a wii naa mmɔri. Mɛsulam ni Sabɛtai la n faa lii Levi dee biini sɛɛ jaa baa.
16Awia, banla n faa bittɛ lii Babilɔn ba la, ɛɛ gunla baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la. Kizeehiŋ Ɛzra faa lizi baala la n ɛɛ domeezi nabɔnzi di lii domee maa biini, ba sɛbi ba sɔna dau. Baaguzi fihiŋ lugli hɔpizii hɔl, ba so bá pigzi ba wia, 17di lii lugli baagu lugli hɔpizii hɔl, ba tuŋ baala la maa n paa hɛrdumazi haana la wia.
Banla n faa paa hɛrdumazi haana wia
18Banla n faa paa hɛrdumazi haanaa sɔnaa keŋ, di lii Kɔraawiizi kizeehina naanna biini,
Jɔzadak biibaal Jesua naanna ani u lulla, Maasɛya, Ɛliɛza, Jarib ani Gɛdalia. 19Ba bɛl maanii faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ vɛɛ u haaŋ. Bɛl maanii faa lizi pebal lii u sela biini, bá lizi u bilchɔg mbusu.
20Ima naanna biini, Hanani ni Zɛbadia.
21Harim ge naanna biini,
Maasɛya, Ɛlija, Sɛmaaya, Jɛhiɛl ani Uzzia.
22Pasur naanna biini,
Ɛliɔnai, Maasɛya, Ismɛl, Nɛtanɛl, Jɔzabad ani Ɛlasa.
23Levi dee ge biini,
Jɔzabad, Simei, Kɛlaaya, ba kaa ra yiruu Kɛlita la, Pɛtahia, Juda ani Ɛliɛza.
24Yiryitta ge biini,
Ɛliasib.
Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuguure ge biini,
Salum, Tɛlɛm ani Uri.
25Izrɛl hina la n kawɛɛ biini,
Parɔs naanna,
Ramia, Izia, Malkija, Mijamin, Ɛliaza, Malkija ani Bɛnaaya.
26Ɛlam ge naanna,
Matania, Zɛkaria, Jɛhiɛl, Abdi, Jɛrɛmɔf ani Ɛlija.
27Zatu ge naanna,
Ɛliɔnai, Ɛliasib, Matania, Jɛrɛmɔf, Zabad ani Aziza.
28Bɛbai ge naanna,
Jɛhɔhanan, Hanania, Zabai ani Atlai.
29Bani ge naannaa,
Mɛsulam, Maluk, Adaaya, Jasub, Sɛɛl ani Jɛrɛmɔf.
30Pahaf Moab naanna,
Adna, Kɛlal, Bɛnaaya, Maasɛya, Matania, Bɛzalɛl, Binui ani Manasɛ.
31Harim ge naannaa,
Ɛliɛza, Isija, Malkija, Sɛmaaya, Simɛɔn, 32Bɛnjamin, Maluk ani Sɛmaria.
33Hasum ge naannaa,
Matɛnai, Mattatta, Zabad, Ɛlifɛlɛt, Jɛrɛmia, Manasɛ ani Simei.
34Bani ge naanna,
Maadai, Amram, Uyɛl, 35Bɛnaaya, Bɛdɛya, Kɛluhi, 36Vania, Mɛrɛmɔf, Ɛliasib, 37Matania, Matɛnai ani Jaasu.
38Binui ge naanna,
Simei, 39Sɛlɛmia, Netan, Adaaya, 40Maknɛdɛbai, Sasai, Sarai, 41Azarɛl, Sɛlɛmia, Sɛmaria, 42Salum, Amaria ani Joosɛf.
43Nɛbɔ naanna,
Jɛyɛl, Matitia, Zabad, Zɛbina, Jaddai, Jowɛl ani Bɛnaaya.
44A nɛra naa maanii faa paa hɛrdumazi haana, baŋhina ni ba hora faa lul biizii, ka ba duŋŋi ba ni a biizi maa.

Title: NƐHƐMIA HƆNNAA BIINI WIA
Content:
Hɔnnaa biini wia
Nɛhɛmia Hɔnna ŋɔ yaa benii gunla Pɛsia koori n faa tɛu ŋmɛnɛɛ ú bir la Jɛrusalɛm, di ga kuari a bolzeŋ koŋlaa la baŋ purgee la di bir ma. Nɛhɛmia faa ga chaali a nɛra bá ma a koŋlii ani gunla ban niŋ ɛɛ bá dɔma gilɛɛ waa tɔ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ a huma biini. U faa hummɔɔ jaa Ɛzra huma la ni, guŋ gil nɛkpila ba di wa du Jɛrusalɛm biini. A tuna, ba faa jaa ra jaami Kɔraawiizi u Dia la biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa jaa aah siwiire, di kpa bahinaa di tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 1
Content:
Nɛhɛmia wiisuŋŋaa wia
1Hakalia biibaal Nɛhɛmia wiŋɔɔlaarɛ keŋ.
Binni tokko n wa helle, baagu la banna yir Kislɛv biini, Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis kora dii saŋa, di mìŋ́ Nɛhɛmia faa du bolzeŋ la banna yir Susa. 2Denii n niwee Hanani ni baala baŋhina lii Juda ba. N pɛɛzi baa gunla Jus hina la baŋ laurɛɛ kaali Babilɔn, ka ba bir ba Juda la wia ani gunla Jɛrusalɛm wia n duwɛɛ.
3Denii ba ŋɔ n be, “Banla maa baŋ laurɛɛ ka ba bir ba Juda la, du tɔɔrɔɔ ni hiihzi biinii. Jɛrusalɛm koŋlaa maanii purgee, ba fuuh u dominuuzenaa ge maa.”
4Miŋ wa nuu wia naa, n so di wii ni biinichɔg, di vɔɔ nua hɔpizaa anɛɛ, di suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ, 5di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ, di dɔɔ sɔŋ, i wia dɔɔ ɔnsii werge la, i ɔɔ ra hiŋ i ni i nɛra nuukpaŋ labuu. I nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ banla n nɔŋŋii di ra hiŋ i widaulaa la be. 6Keŋŋi digna, di pilli i siwee nuu i balii n suŋŋii di ra tɛɛ i balaa Izrɛl hina, wibaŋa ni hamuŋa maa. N ŋɔ n sɛɛ chɔgrii lugɔ yaa Izrɛl hina, di kpa n ni n mɛɛ diahina maa jaa, ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ zuu i ni. 7Yaa ɛɛ biinikpola wiarɛ di zuu i ni. Yaa waa sɛɛwɛ hiŋ i wiŋɔɔlaa, i widaulaa ani i Gbɔgni la hiŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ i balii Moosis la.
8A liizi i baglaazi la hiŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Moosis, di ŋɔ, ‘Di ii wanna hiŋ ni wibii, n daŋ gil ii maa yaari hɛrdumazi biine. 9Ka di ii daŋ bir ba n be ni wibii, di ra hiŋ n wiŋɔɔlaa, haali ii banla gba baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛhjaŋa la, n daŋ chaali ia di bir ba bɔr la miŋ lizɛɛ, n sɔŋ du de la.’
10Ba ɛɛ i balaa ni nɛra la hiŋ kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ ni i banonii di lɛɛu. 11Kɔraawiizi, keŋŋi digna di nuu mìŋ́ i balii naa ni i balaa la maa n na kpa i sɔŋ girme wiisuŋŋaa. Gil mìŋ́ i balii na n kipar zinaa, di gil n wia par baal naa.”
Minuu faa ra kpogli a koorizeŋ siŋ libee.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 2
Content:
Nɛhɛmia n bittɛ la Jɛrusalɛm wia
1Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis kora dii binni tokkohiŋ biini, baagu la banna yir Niisan la, n kpa siŋ la ń ga tɛu, di u ra di. U ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa nawɛɛ n biini n chɔkkɛ. 2Denii u pɛɛziŋ, “Zinaa ɛrɛɛ i biini chɔgi, hiŋ waa wiiyɛi? A daŋ ɛɛ biinichɔg wiarɛ.”
Uŋ pɛɛzi gunla, ɔnsii lawiŋ, 3ka n ŋɔ u be, “Jara, Kɔ́raawiizi gil i du de saŋa maa. Bɛɛ n baani n biini wàá chɔgɛi? Bolzeŋ la miŋ liwɛɛ, n naabaala ŋmama du de la maanii purgee, u dominuuzenaa ge maa fuuh.”
4A koorizeŋ pɛɛziŋ, “Bɛɛ i ra nyiŋŋi n ɛɛ tɛinɛi?”
Denii n suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ, 5ka ŋɔ a koorizeŋ be, “Jara, di n wia parii, nuu n suŋŋaa, di gil n la Juda, n naabaala hɛri la baŋ hug baa la, di ga kuari a bolzeŋ ma.”
6A saŋa, di a koorizeŋ ni u haaŋ sogo, u pɛɛziŋ, “Ɛrɛɛ í ga birgi mag ani saŋa bɛɛ i bir banɛi?” A paruu, u tɛŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ. Awia, n tɛu saŋa la min niŋ la ka bir ba.
7Denii n kaa suŋŋuu ŋɔ ú tɛŋ hɔna, ń kpa la ga tɛɛ Muu Yufretis baŋgia hɛri nabɔnzi, bá gil nɛra tɔ n see di binniŋ guŋŋ ń ga hel Juda ni alaanfia. 8N kaa ŋɔ u be lugɔ ú tɛŋ hɔŋ, ń ga tɛɛ baal la banna yir Asaf la n na binni koori kɔrni la, ú tɛŋ daazi ń teŋri ga kuari gbessi du diikpeg la n dugli Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuzenaa, a bolzeŋ koŋliizeŋ ani n dia. Kɔraawiizi n faa du n be wia, kunla maa miŋ suŋŋɛɛ lii a koori be, u tɛmbuu. 9Denii n faa kpa la Muu Yufretis baŋgia hɛri nabɔnzi la be, di ga kpa a hɔna tɛɛ baa. A koorizeŋ faa gillɔɔ laallɔɔra nabɔnzi ni banla n tinni zagra faa tɔ n see ga hel de.
10Denii baal bɛl baŋ faa ra yir Sanbalat, u lii Bɛf Hɔrɔn ni u dɔŋhiŋ bɛl banna yir Tobia, n faa ɛɛ Ammɔn hina nabɔma bɛl, nuu lugɔ nɛbɛl ballɔɔ, ú wa kuari Izrɛl hina bolzeŋ la ma. A guŋ faa ra fuuh ba baana werge maa.
Nɛhɛmia n gaagɛɛ binni Jɛrusalɛm koŋlaa wia
11N kpa la Jɛrusalɛm, di ga du de hɔpizaa ahoro. 12N ni baala tama izi hamuŋa bɛl, ka maa nɛr maa be ŋɔwɛɛ gunla Kɔraawiizi n kpawɛɛ du n bampirii lugɔ ń wa ɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm. A saŋa, kuntinnaa faa waa hoo, di kawee la miŋ tinnɛɛ la bɛŋ lɛi.
13Hamuŋa ni, n ga Waluu Dominuuzeŋ la lii, di kpa la unla banna yir Hohobia Kɔlɔŋ la, di kaa lii de di kpa la unla banna yir Nabina Dominuuzeŋ la. Aabuu n binni, di na gunla Jɛrusalɛm koŋlaa maa n purgee ni gunla u dominuuzenaa maa n fuuhwe. 14N lii de la Bule Dominuuzeŋ la, di lii de ga hel Koori Pol la. Ka bɔr faa waa hoo, n kawee ga. 15Awia, n tuu a waluu a hamuŋa ni, di binni a koŋlii. A tuna, n kaa bir ga a Waluu Dominuuzeŋ la zuu a bolzeŋ biini. 16A nabɔnzi faa waa zum bɔr la maa miŋ kaalɛɛ gɛɛ wii la minna ɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n faa haa waa Jus hina gɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina gɛɛ nabɔnzenaa gɛɛ ba nabɔnzi gɛɛ nɛra la n niŋ hum a huma la be ŋɔwɛɛ, wii la miŋ ballɛ ń wa ɛɛ.
17Awia, n ŋɔ ba be, “Ií na tɔɔrɔɔ la biini yaa n duwɛɛ. Jɛrusalɛm maanii purgee chɔɔ, u dominuuzenaa maa fuuh. Ií gil ya kuari Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii la ma. Di yaa ɛɛ guŋ, yaa wàá ka du hiihzi biini.” 18N jaa ŋɔ ba be gunla Kɔraawiizi n suŋ n ni ani wii la koorizeŋ la n ŋɔ n be.
Ba sɛɛ, di ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya faari di kuari a koŋlii ma.” Awia, ba faari di ra hum a hunnanii naa.
19Sanbalat la n ɛɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn hinuu, Tobia la n ɛɛ Ammɔn hina nabɔma ani Gɛsɛm la n ɛɛ Lɔrbi la n wa nuu guŋ, ba ra mam yaa, di ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ, di ra ŋɔ, “Beedee ii ra ɛɛ kennei? Ii ra di a koorizenne mmɔri gɛɛ?”
20Denii n ŋɔ ba be, “Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la daŋ tɛɛ yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ ani fɔŋŋa, yá wer mau, dikuu yaa n ɛɛ u balaa wia. Yaa daŋ bir mau. Ama, iawaa nonii waa Jɛrusalɛm kapɛttɛ ni jaawɛ.”

Title: NƐHƐMIA 3
Content:
Baŋ bittɛ ra ma Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii wia
1Kenne ba faa bir kuari a bolzeŋ koŋliizeŋ ma. Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Ɛliasib ni u dɔŋahina, faa kuari dominuuzeŋ la banna yir Peeza Dominuuzeŋ la ma, di kpau du Kɔraawiizi nonee, ka du u gbessi. Ba faa ma a koŋliizeŋ guŋŋ di ga hel dominuuzeŋ la banna yir Kalfa Diijaŋ ni Hananɛl Diijaŋ la, di kpau du Kɔraawiizi nonee.
2Bolzeŋ Jɛriko baala ge ma a koŋlii bɔr la n kaa ra hiŋ. Baŋ wa hel see, Imri biibaal Zakur ge ma hiŋ.
3Hasɛnaa biibaala ge kuari Nyinni Dominuuzeŋ la hiŋ, di du u dolli, gbessi, lugbidaazi ani u kattibɔra. 4Yuria biibaal Mɛrɛmɔf, u naabaal faa ɛɛ Hakɔz, ge ma a koŋlii bɔr la n hiŋŋɛ. Bɛrɛkia biibaal Mɛsulam, u naabaal faa ɛɛ Mɛsɛzabɛl, ge faa kuari a koŋlii yeŋ ma hiŋ. Baana biibaal Zadɔk ge kuari a koŋlii yeŋ ma hiŋ. 5Tɛkua baala ge kuari ma a koŋlii bɔr la n hiŋŋɛ. Banna ma la, ba nabɔnzenaa la n du a bol waa sɛɛwɛ bá hum huma la ba binna n tɛɛ baa la.
6Denii Pasia biibaal Jɔyada ni Bɛsɔdɛya biibaal Mɛsulam ge kaa kuari Jɛsana Dominuuzeŋ la hiŋ. Ba faa du u dolli, gbessi, lugbidaazi ani u kattibɔra. 7Gibiɔn hinuu Mɛlatia, Mɛrɔnɔf hinuu Jadɔn ani Gibiɔn ni Mizpa baala, ge ma a koŋlii guŋŋ di ga hel Muu Yufretis Wiicholii nabɔma dia. 8Hahaaya biibaal Uziɛl, n faa ɛɛ saliŋ luuri, kuari ma bɔr la n hiŋŋɛ. Hanania la ge n faa ɛɛ tulaale kuari, la genii faa ma bɔr la n hiŋŋɛ. Gunnɛ ba faa ɛɛ, di kuari Jɛrusalɛm koŋliizeŋ la maa ma guŋŋ di ga hel u bɔr la banna yir Koŋlii War la. 9Denii Hur biibaal Rɛfaaya, n faa ɛɛ nabɔma di ra binni Jɛrusalɛm keŋkere bɛl, ge faa kuari ma u yeŋ hiŋ. 10Harumaf biibaal Jɛdaaya ge kuari ma u bɔr la n dugli u dia, di hiŋ. Hasabnɛya biibaal Hatus ge kuari ma u yeŋ hiŋ. 11Harim biibaal Malkija ni Pahaf Moab biibaal Hasub genii kuarɛɛ ma u bɔr la n hiŋŋɛ ani u bɔr la banna yir Paanuu Ɔɔzibɔra Diijaŋ la. 12Halɔhɛs biibaal Salum la n faa ɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm keŋkere bɛl nabɔma ni u biihaana ge kuari ma u yeŋ hiŋ.
13Baal la baŋ faa ra yir Hanun ge ni Zanoa hinaa ge faa ma u bɔr la banna yir Waluu Dominuuzeŋ la. Baŋ wa kuaruu ma, ba du de domininuuzeŋ gbessi ni a kattibɔra. Ba faa kuaruubuu ma guŋŋ nogumzi kagboŋ, di ga hel u bɔr la banna yir Kpaga Dominuuzeŋ la.
14Rɛkab biibaal la baŋ faa ra yir Malkija n faa ɛɛ Bɛf Hakɛrɛm paga nabɔma, genii faa kuari Kpaga Dominuuzeŋ la, di du u dolli, gbessi, lugbidaazi ani u kattibɔra.
15Baal bɛl baŋ faa ra yir Kol Hɔzɛ biibaal Salum, n faa ɛɛ Mizpa paga nabɔma ge ma a koŋlii bɔr la banna yir Bule Dominuuzeŋ la. U faa kuaruubuu ma, di tɔ u nyuu, di du u gbessi ni a kattikuna. U kaa kuari ma Silɔam Pol koŋlii la n dugli Koori Kambol guŋŋ di ga hel lɔŋa la n lii Koori Deevid Bolzeŋ di tuu ra la la. 16Azbuk biibaal Nɛhɛmia la n faa ɛɛ Bɛf Zur paga yeŋ nabɔma ge faa kuari a koŋlii bɔr la n kawɛɛ la ma guŋŋ di chaŋ Koori Deevid Ŋmam, di ga hel pol la baŋ kiwee ani Laallɔkpega Dia la.
17Levi dee ni ba sitɔɔri Bani biibaal Rɛhum ge kuari ma hiŋ. Hasabia la n faa ɛɛ Keila paga yeŋ nabɔma, ge faa kuari ma ba paga koŋlii yeŋ di hiŋ. 18Baal bɛl ge baŋ faa ra yir Hɛnadad biibaal Binui n faa ɛɛ Keila paga yeŋ nabɔma, ni u bol hina faa kuari ma a koŋlii yeŋ di hiŋ. 19Baŋ ga hel de, Jesua biibaal Ɛza, n faa ɛɛ Mizpa nabɔma ge faa kuari a koŋlii bɔr la n du ba dɔŋkuna dia see guŋŋ di ga hel a koŋlii sirii. 20Baal bɛl baŋ faa ra yir Zabai ge biibaal Baruk faa aah siwii, di faari a sirii di kuaruu ma guŋŋ di ga hel Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Ɛliasib dominua. 21Yuria biibaal Mɛrɛmɔf, u naabaal ɛɛ Hakɔz, ge faa ma lii Ɛliasib dia dominua ga hel a dia tuna.
22Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n soge bar Jɛrusalɛm, ge ma a koŋlii yeŋ di hiŋ. 23Bɛnjamin ni Hasub ge faa kuari ma a koŋlii bɔra la n du ba dia see. Maasɛya biibaal Azaria, u naabaallɛ faa Anania, ge faa ma a koŋlii bɔr la n dugli u dia. 24Hɛnadad biibaal Binui ge kuari a koŋlii ma lii Azaria dia guŋŋ di ga hel a koŋlii sirii. 25Uzai biibaal Palal ge kuari a koŋlii yeŋ ma chaŋ a koŋlii sirii ni diijaŋ la n saagɛɛ lii kooridia chiŋ n dugli guuri diŋŋee la. Parɔs biibaal Pɛdaaya ge kuari ma hiŋ. 26Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa la n faa du Ɔfɛl giŋgimii la ge kuari a koŋlii ma guŋŋ di ga hel u wiifurii, di chaŋ Nii Dominuuzeŋ la, di ra la u diijaŋ la n saagɛɛ la zɛɛ. 27Tɛkua baala ge kaa ma a koŋlii guŋŋ lii diijaŋ la n saagɛɛ, di ga hel Ɔfɛl koŋlii la. Ba mai nɛɛhinnɛ guŋ.
28Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ge kuari ma a koŋlii bɔr la n pɛli Zagu Dominuuzeŋ la di ra la wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag. Bɛl maa ma u dia see. 29Ima biibaal Zadɔk ge ma a koŋlii bɔr la n chaŋ u dia hiŋ. Sɛkania biibaal Sɛmaaya la n faa ɛɛ Wiifurii Dominuuzeŋ guuri ge ma a koŋlii yeŋ hiŋ. 30Sɛlɛmia biibaal Hanania ni Zalaf biibambinumbɛlhiŋ, Hanun ge kaa kuari a koŋlii yeŋ ma hiŋ. Bɛrɛkia biibaal Mɛsulam ge kuari a koŋlii bɔr la n chaŋ u dia ma. 31Saliŋ luuri Malkija ge kuari ma a koŋlii guŋŋ di ga hel Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa ni kɔkɔɔza dia n chaŋ Mifkad Dominuuzeŋ guŋŋ di ga chug dia la n du u sirii chiŋ la. 32Saliŋ luura ni kɔkɔɔza ge kuari a koŋlii tuna ma, di lii u sirii chiŋ dia guŋŋ di ga chug Peeza Dominuuzeŋ.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 4
Content:
Nɛhɛmia dɔma wia
1Sanbalat n wa nuuwɛ lugɔ yaa Jus hina bittɔɔ kuari a koŋlii di ra ma la, u baaŋ fuuh werge maa, u ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ. 2Awia, u jaa chi u dɔŋahina ni bolzeŋ Samaria hina laallɔɔra be, di ŋɔ, “Beedee Jus hina nɛvɛɛlaa naa ra ɛɛ gunnɛi? Ba kaa ra nyiŋŋuu bá bir kuari ba koŋlii naa maa? Ba daŋ lizi mbusuzii gɛɛ? Ba daŋ maubuu tuŋ hɔpizi kpaŋaa? Ba daŋ kaa wer kpa bifuuhlaa naa di maa?”
3Denii Ammɔn hinuu Tobia n chigɛ u kɛra la ge ŋɔ, “Beedee koŋliire ba ra ma kennei? Di nyɛgɛ gba haŋ tinni ba bia koŋlii naa ni gba, u daŋ chol.”
4Awia, n suŋŋi wiizi di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, nuu yaa be, dikuu banna gbɛlli yaa wia. Gil chagzaa naa banna chagzi yaa naa laŋŋi ba ni. Kpa baa du ba dɔma nonee, bá lɔ ba laal, di lauri baa kaali hɛrdumazi. 5Gilɛɛ gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa, di gilɛɛ suuh ba wichɔgaa wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba chagzi yaa banla n na mau.”
6Awia, yaa faa ma a koŋlii guŋŋ di ga hel u galga, dikuubɛɛwiai, a nɛra maanii faa aah siwii.
7Denii Sanbalat, Tobia, Lɔrbizi, Ammɔn ani Asdɔd hina maa n faa wa nuuwɛ lugɔ yaa wettoo di ra ma Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii hiŋ, di ra fargi u bowooni, ba baana fuuh werge maa. 8Awia, ba maa ta jina bá ga lɔ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di koozi wia du yaa ni. 9Ka yaa faa suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, di lizi nɛra ba ra guu yaa wibaŋa ni hamuŋa maa.
10A biinii, Juda hina ŋɔ, “A maara bɔra ra huauh, hembugle la ge du kaŋ werge. Awia, yaa wàá wer kuari a koŋlii ma.”
11Yaa dɔma ge ŋɔ, “Mɔɔ ka ba zum guŋ gɛɛ di na yaa, di yaa zuu ba biini kpu baa, a huma tuŋ.”
12Denii Jus hina la n soge dugli baa la, ba di wa ŋɔ yaa be nua bufi, di ŋɔ, “Bɔr la maa iin niŋ ga, ba daŋ teŋ yaa di lɔ yaa.”
13Awia, n gil baŋhina lii domeezi biini, di vɔɔ ni ba tokobizi, kandaazi ani hozi, di ga guu ba bariizi koŋlii bɔra la baŋ faa haa waa mawɛɛ tuŋ la. 14Miŋ binni wia guŋŋ di wa kaali, n izi chi, ka ŋɔ nabɔnzenaa, nabɔnzi ani a nɛra maa be, “Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm baa. Ií ra liizi Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge, u wia kaa dɔɔ ɔnsii werge la, ka izi naa tɛɛ ii lulla, ii biizi, ii haana ani ii diini.”
15Yaa dɔma n wa nuuwɛ lugɔ yaa zum ba jina la baŋ tawɛɛ la wiarɛ, Kɔraawiizi ge kaa chɔguu la, yaa jaa bir la a koŋlii bɔr, bɛl maa kaa gaa hum u huma.
16Di lii a hɔl hiŋ, n huŋhunna hiŋ yeŋ ɔɔ ra humuu, ka ba yeŋ ge laali ba laal laala di kpogli kandaazi, laal pɛrɛtuzi ani hozi di guu. Nabɔnzi la ge chi Juda hina la 17n na ma a koŋlii la har. Banla n na chi kuna ɔɔ kpa nonii bɛllɛ di ra hum, ka kpa bɛl ge di kpogli dɔŋkuŋ. 18A maara bɛl maa ge ɔɔ kpa u tokobi vɔɔ u chara ka ra hum. Nɛr la n ɔɔ faa ra huuh bensuno la ge ɔɔ chi n kɛra.
19Denii n ŋɔ a nabɔnzenaa, nabɔnzi ani a nɛra maa be, “Huma la bɔr wassɔɔ, yaa waa ɔɔ chi a koŋlii zɛɛ dugli dɔŋa. 20Di ii wa nuu bensunoniina wiraa bɔr la maa, ií ra ba yaa be de. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la daŋ naa tɛɛ yaa!”
21Awia, yaa yeŋ ɔɔ faa ra humuu, ka yaa yeŋ ge kpogli kandaazi, di lii chɔɔzimpikke guŋŋ di ga hel saŋa la bɔr n ɔɔ waa lauri siwee, chinchiŋwilaa ra lii la. 22A saŋa hiŋ, n ŋɔ a nɛra be lugɔ baal maa ni u hiini ɔɔ du Jɛrusalɛm hamuŋa ni di ra guu yaa, ka di hɔɔ wa pizɔɔ bá ra hum. 23Miŋ gɛɛ n niuna gɛɛ n huŋhunna gɛɛ a guure n faa du n be la, bɛl maa faa waa u laala witte, ka ɔɔ kpogli u dɔŋkuŋ, haali di u waa la ú ga ɛɛ nii gba.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 5
Content:
Nɛhɛmia n hiini nyaara wia
1A saŋa hiŋ, baala ni ba haana faa nuumi di ra du ba dɔŋa Jus hina. 2Baŋhina ra ŋɔ, “Yaa biizi kpillɔɔ werge. Yaa ra nyiŋŋi miarɛ yá di, di piri.”
3Denii baŋhina ge faa ra ŋɔ, “Yaa kpa yaa kooni, yaa grepu daazi kooni ani diinii dau talma, ka ya wer na mia nɛnnɛ a hel yaa dii, lɔchɔgii saŋa.”
4Baŋhina ge ŋɔ, “Yaa kim kebeere turgi yaa kooni ni yaa grepu daazi kooni lampoo tɛɛ koori. 5Yaa maa ɛɛ nɛdeekpannɛ. Gunla ba biizi n duwɛɛ, gunnɛ yaa gba biizi du. Ka aabuu la, yaa biizii yaa kpa birgi yoma. Yaa biihaana baŋhinaa yaa kpa yoo, ba birgi yoma. Yaa waa fɔŋŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa kooni ni yaa grepu daazi kooni maanii birgi nɛra baŋhina hora.”
6Miŋ wa nuu ba nuumaa naa, n baaŋ fuuh werge maa. 7Denii n fɛ a wia nfɛrɛ guŋŋ ka hau a nabɔnzenaa ni a nabɔnzi ni, di ŋɔ ba be, “Ɛrɛɛ ii ra sag ii himmaa lulla nii gunnɛi?” Denii n chaali nɛkpila ya binni a wia biini. 8N ŋɔ ba be, “Filaŋkennaa, yaa bittɔɔ yau yaa lulla Jus hina la baŋ faa yoowe tɛɛ banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la. Ka ii kaa biruu ra yoo baa, ka ba kaa wa yoo baa tɛɛ yaa.” Denii ba maa faa so kirkirkir, dikuu baŋ waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ ba ŋɔ wia.
9Denii n kaa ŋɔ, “Wii naa iinna ɛɛ naa waa deŋlee. A dɛkkɔɔ iinna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua, di ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa. Guŋ daŋ gil yaa dɔma la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la, wàá na bɔr di ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ. 10Miŋwaa ni n lulla ni n huŋhunna ra kim a nɛraa kebee ni mia, ka yaa wàá fir baa bá turgi. 11Ií gil ba kima maa tɛɛ baa, di kebeere gɛɛ mia gɛɛ siŋ gɛɛ ɔlivi nuurɛ. Ií bir kpa ba kooni, grepu daazi kooni maa ani ba diini tɛɛ baa manaŋ!”
12Ba ŋɔ, “Yaa daŋ bir kpaa tɛɛ baa. Yaa wàá ka lɛɛ baa kummaa di jaa. Yaa daŋ hiŋ i nua.”
Denii n faa gil Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la maa chaali, di gil nabɔnzenaa ni nabɔnzi hɛɛhzi lugɔ ba daŋ ɛɛ gunla baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ hiŋ. 13Denii n lizi n tagta di zigluu, ka ŋɔ a nɛra be, “Kenne Kɔ́raawiizi zigli nɛr la maa n niŋ vɛɛ nua naa hiŋaa. U dia ni u kundɔɔlaa maa daŋ lii u nonii.”
Awia, a nɛra maa ŋɔ, “Ami!” Ka ba jaa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, di ɛɛ gunla baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ ba daŋ ɛɛ la.
14Di lii Koorizeŋ Aatazɛgzis kora dii binni tokkohiŋ biinii, ba liziŋ n ɛɛ nabɔma Juda hɛri guŋŋ di wa hel u binni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni anɛɛhiŋ. Binni fidaanɛɛrɛ guŋ, di n ni n lulla bɛl maa haa waa diwee la baŋ ɔɔ ra tɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma la diwee. 15Ka nabɔma la n faa diwee mɔɔ ka a wa heliŋ lawaa, ɔɔ faa ra sunni a nɛraa werge maa. U ɔɔ faa lɛɛ baabuu saliŋhuŋŋa kebisau tokkoanɛɛ, diwee ani siŋ hɔpizii maa. A nabɔma harbɔɔhiŋra ge ɔɔ faa kpogli baabuu di ra sunni, ka miŋwaa waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ, dikuu minna ɔm Kɔraawiizi wia. 16Ama, miŋwaa faa kpa n siaahmu maanii du a koŋlii mai wia biini. N huŋhunna maanii chaali a koŋlii zɛɛ, yaa ra hum a huma. Yaa waa hɛri maa lɛɛwɛ.
17Aŋ faa weruu ra tɛɛ Jus hina ni ba nabɔnzi kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fii diwee digiidigii, ba ra di, di ɔɔ kaa tɛɛ hɛrdumazi nɛra la n bar yaa la n ɔɔ faa ba n be diwee, ba maa ra di. 18Hɔpizii maa, nau, penanaa anumbɛl ani zagkpilaa ba ɔɔ faa daali tɛŋ. A hɔpizaa fi maa, siŋ maa deere ba ɔɔ faa daali su bɔr. Annii maa biini, ka maa ɔɔ faa lɛɛ kummaa lii a hɛri nabɔma kuntɛɛlaa biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, a nɛra tɔɔrɔɔ faa nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ.
19Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gil n wia parii, í ra liizi n wia, dikuu gunla miŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ nɛra naa wia.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 6
Content:
Baŋ ta Nɛhɛmia wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina wia
1Sanbalat, Tobia ani Gɛsɛm la n ɛɛ Lɔrbi la ni yaa dɔma n wa nuuwɛ lugɔ n bittɔɔ kuari a koŋlii ma, haali di tɔɔgi u bowooni maa, ka n haa waa u dominuuzenaa gbessi waa duwɛɛ la, 2Sanbalat ni Gɛsɛm tili ŋɔ n be, “Ba ya na dɔŋa bola la bɛl n du Ono Lɛl biini.”
Ka ba faa ra ɛɛ dawarii bá ɛɛŋ wichɔgii bɛl. 3Denii n faa hum n balaa bá ga ŋɔ ba be, “N na ɛɛ wizeŋ bɛllɛ, awia, màá wer tuu ba ii be de. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń gil a huma ka tuu ba ii benei?” 4Bunaazu maanii ba faa tiliŋ keŋ himmaa, n ge ɔɔ bir ŋɔ a wikpaŋ.
5Denii bunue hiŋ, Sanbalat hum u balii, di sɛbi hɔŋ ŋɔ ú kpa wa tɛŋ, ka waa u nua tɔwɛɛ. 6Kenne u faa sɛbi a hɔŋ biini,
“Hɛssi maa hina nuuwɔɔ lugɔ i ni Jus hina la ɛɛ nuukpannɛ di ra nyiŋŋi ii du dɔŋ, awiarɛ ii bir kuari a koŋlii di ra ma. Gɛsɛm ge ŋɔ wibiire! Yaa kaa nuu lugɔ hinuu ra nyiŋŋi i birgi ba koori. 7A guŋ wia, i lizi Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzii, bá sii i wia tɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di ŋɔ, ‘Koori du Judaa!’ Filaŋkeŋ, a koorizeŋ daŋ nuu a wii naa. Awia, ba ya ta jina.”
8Denii n tili ŋɔ u be, “Wia naa maa hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa waa wibii ɛɛwɛ. I himmaa laakal wiŋɔɔlaarɛ.”
9Ba ra ɔnzi yaabuu, di ra fɛ, “Ba bɔra daŋ huah a huma humaa wia, bá gil a humaa.” Awia, n suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛŋ fɔŋŋa filaŋkeŋ!”
10A hɔl bɛl, n la Dɛlaaya biibaal Sɛmaaya dia, u naabaal genii faa Mɛhɛtabɛl. U faa suah diarɛ, wàá ka wer lii baaŋ. U ŋɔ n be, “Gil ya la ga suah Kɔraawiizi Dia biini, ka tɔɔgi u dominuuzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ra nyiŋŋuu bá wa kpui hamuŋa naa.”
11Denii n ŋɔ u be, “Mìŋ́ baal du keŋ di chɔ ra suah? Ń chɔ ga suah Kɔraawiizi Dia biini, dikuu n miibɔɔ wiaa? Akai, màá ɛɛ guŋ!” 12N faa nawɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi lɛi hum Sɛmaaya. Sanbalat ni Tobiare lɔu paah, di ŋɔ ú wa ŋɔ wia du n ni. 13Ba kpaubuu ú wa ɔnziŋ, ń ɛɛ wichɔgaa lugɔ kennaa uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa, bá jaa chɔg n sɔŋ, di duŋ hiihzi.
14Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, a liizi gunla Tobia ni Sanbalat n ɛɛwɛ. A liizi gunla dɔgtɛɛ Noadia la n ɛɛ haaŋ ni dɔgtɛɛzi la maa n faa ra nyiŋŋi bá ɔnziŋ la wia.
A koŋlii mai tunaa wia
15Baagu la banna yir Ɛlul, u hɔpizaa tokko ni anuehiŋ hɔllɛ, ba faa ma a koŋlii tuŋ. Hɔpizaa tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanɛɛrɛ ba faa kpa mau tuŋ. 16Yaa dɔma ani hɛssi la maa hina n bar yaa n wa nuu guŋ, ɔnsii faa lau baa, ba bɔra huah, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa zummɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la hiinaare gillɛ a huma hum.
17A saŋa hiŋ, Juda hina nabɔnzenaa faa ra sɛbi hɔna kpila di ra tɛɛ Tobia, u ge bir sɛbi ra tɛɛ baa. 18Jus hinuu Ara biibaal Sɛkania n faa ɛɛ u hila wia, Juda hina kpila maanii faa chigɛ u har. Di kaa kpa jaa, u biibaal Jɛhɔhanan ge faa kpa Mɛsulam biihaannɛ. A Mɛsulam ge mɛɛrɛ faa Bɛrɛkia. 19A nɛra ɔɔ faa bagli wipazi la maa Tobia n ɛɛwɛnɛ tɛŋ, ka bir ga ŋɔ u be gunla n ge n ŋɔwɛɛ. Tobia sɛbi hɔna tɛŋ, di ra ɔnziŋ.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 7
Content:
1Baŋ wa kuari a koŋlii ma tuŋ, n du u domininuuzenaa gbessi maa, di lizi dominuuguure, yiryitta ani Levi dee. 2Denii n jaa lizi n lulli Hanani ni Hanania la n faa ɛɛ a diikpeg nabɔma, ba ra binni Jɛrusalɛm ni. Hanania faa ɛɛ biinihuŋŋu hinnɛ, di kaa ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi kaali nɛkpila maa. 3Denii n ŋɔ ba be lugɔ nɛr maa gilɛɛ waa pilli a domininuuzenaa, di wiizi waa baŋŋɛ. Bá ɔɔ karaa, di a guure haa du de. N kaa ŋɔ ba be lugɔ ba lizi Jɛrusalɛm biini hina, bá ɛɛ guure. Ba ɔɔ dɔɔ guuribɔra di ra chi dizi, ka baŋhina ge ɔɔ chi dugli ba diini.
Nɛra la n bittɛ ba la sɔna
4A saŋa hiŋ, Jɛrusalɛm faa ɛɛ bolzenne werge, ka u nɛra faa waa kpil, u diini ge faa waa kuarɛɛ ma. 5Awia, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la faa kpa wia du n bampirii lugɔ n chaali a nabɔnzenaa, nabɔnzi ani a nɛra maa, di sɛbi ba sɔna. N na gunla baŋ sɛbi banla n felee ba la naabaala luge hɔŋ. Kenne n faa na gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ.
6Nɛra la Babilɔn Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza, n faa lɔ Jɛrusalɛm hina laal, di lauri baa kaali Babilɔn, ba ga birgi u yoma la n bittɛ ba ba himmaa bola la n du Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda la, 7ba sitɔɔraa faa Zɛrubabɛl, Jesua, Nɛhɛmia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Mɔdɛkai, Bilsan, Mispɛrɛf, Bigvai, Nɛhum ani Baana.
Izrɛl baala la magaa keŋ,
8Parɔs naanna faa du kagboŋa anɛɛ ani kalfa ni tokkoahoro ni fidaanɛɛ, 2,172.
9Sɛfatia naanna faa du kalfaahoro ni tokkoahoro ni fidaanɛɛ, 372.
10Ara naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanɛɛ, 652.
11Pahaf Moab naanna n lii Jesua ni Joab domeezi biine, faa du kagboŋa anɛɛ ani kalfa ŋmantannaazi ni fidiŋmantannaazi, 2,818.
12Ɛlam naanna faa du kagboŋ ani kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanaazu, 1,254.
13Zatu naanna faa du kalfa ŋmantannaazi ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anue, 845.
14Zakai naanna faa du kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokkoahoro, 760.
15Binui naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoanɛɛ ni ŋmantannaazi, 648.
16Bɛbai naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokko ni ŋmantannaazi, 628.
17Azgad naanna faa du kagboŋa anɛɛ ni kalfaahoro ni tokko ni anɛɛ, 2,322.
18Adonikam naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoahoro ni aniidaanɛɛ, 667.
19Bigvai naanna faa du kagboŋa anɛɛ ni tokkoahoro ni aniidaanɛɛ, 2,067.
20Adin naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanue, 655.
21Ata n lii Hɛzɛkia domeezi biini naanna faa du tokkoanaazu ni fidiŋmantannaazi, 98.
22Hasum naanna faa du kalfaahoro ni tokko ni ŋmantannaazi, 328.
23Bɛzai naanna faa du kalfaahoro ni tokko ni anaazu, 324.
24Harif baala, kalfa ni fidaanɛɛ, 112.
25Gibiɔn naanna faa du tokkoanaazu ni fidaanue, 95.
26Bɛtlihɛm ni Nɛtɔfa baala faa du kalfa ni tokkoanaazu ni ŋmantannaazi, 188.
27Anatɔf baala faa du kalfa ni tokko ni ŋmantannaazi, 128.
28Bɛf Azmavɛf baala faa du tokkoanɛɛ ni anɛɛ, 42.
29Kiriaf Jiarim, Kɛfira ani Bɛɛrɔf baala maa faa du kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni ahoro, 743.
30Rama ni Gɛba baala faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokko ni kpaŋ, 621.
31Mikmas baala faa du kalfa ni tokko ni anɛɛ, 122.
32Bɛtɛl ni Ai baala faa du kalfa ni tokko ni ahoro, 123.
33Nɛbɔ nɛɛhiŋ naanna faa du tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanɛɛ, 52.
34Ɛlam nɛɛhiŋ la naanna faa du kagboŋ ani kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanaazu, 1,254.
35Harim naanna faa du kalfaahoro ni tokko, 320.
36Bolzeŋ Jɛriko baala maa faa du kalfaahoro ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anue, 345.
37Lɔɔd, Hadid ani Ono baala maa faa du kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokko ni kpaŋ, 721.
38Sɛnaa naanna faa du kagboŋa ahoro ani kalfa kabɛl ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ, 3,930.
39Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
Jɛdaaya naanna n lii Jesua domeezi biini baala faa du kalfa kabɛl ni tokkoahoro ni fidaahoro, 973.
40Ima naanna faa du kagboŋ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fidaanɛɛ, 1,052.
41Pasur naanna faa du kagboŋ ani kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni aniidaanɛɛ, 1,247.
42Harim naanna faa du kagboŋ ni fidaaniidaanɛɛ, 1,017.
43Di lii Levi dee biini,
Jesua ni Kadmiɛl n lii Hɔdavia domee biini naanna faa du tokkoahoro ni fidaanazu, 74.
44Yiryitta,
Asaf naanna faa du kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni ŋmantannaazi, 148.
45Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuguure,
Salum, Ata, Talmɔn, Akub, Hatita ani Sobai naanna ge maa faa du kalfa ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni ŋmantannaazi, 138.
46Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa naa,
Ziha, Hasufa, Tabayɔf,
47Kɛrɔs, Sia, Padɔn
48Lɛbana, Hagaba, Salmai,
49Hanan, Gidɛl, Gahar,
50Rɛyaaya, Rɛzin, Nɛkɔda
51Gazam, Uza, Pasia,
52Bɛsai, Mɛyunim, Nɛfusim,
53Bakbuk, Hakufa, Hahur,
54Bazluf, Mɛhida, Hasa,
55Bakɔs, Sisɛra, Tɛmaa,
56Nɛzia ani Hatifa naanna.
57Solomɔn balaa la naanna n bittɛ bau keŋ,
Sotai, Sɔfɛrɛf, Pɛrida,
58Jaala, Dakɔn, Gidɛl,
59Sɛfatia, Hatil,
Pɔkɛrɛf Hazɛbam ani Amɔn.
60Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa ani Solomɔn balaa naanna faa du kalfaahoro ni tokkoanaazu ni fidaanɛɛ, 392.
61Nɛra naa sɔna n hiŋ dɔŋa ɛnnaa, lii bola la baŋ faa ra yir Tel Mɛla, Tɛl Hasa, Kerub, Adɔn ani Imaa. Ka ba faa waa wette bá bagli lugɔ ba domeezi ɛɛ Izrɛl hina naannaa.
62Dɛlaaya, Tobia ani Nɛkɔda naanna faa du kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anɛɛ, 642.
63Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
Hɔbaaya, Hakɔz ani Bazilai naanna. Bazilai naa faa kpa Giliad hinuu Bazilai biihaannɛ. Awiarɛ ba faa ra yiruu Bazilai la.
64A nɛra naa faa nyiŋŋi ba domeezi lugzii huhzi. Awia, ba faa lizi baabuu Kɔraawiizi kizeehina biini ha, dikuu baŋ faa doŋŋe Kɔraawiizi be wia. 65Awia, Jus hɛri nabɔma faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ba gilɛɛ kaa di diwee la baŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la, see Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ wa du de, di kpa Urim ni Tumim di ra hum.
66Nɛra la maa n faa bittɛ lii Babilɔn ba la, maa faa du kagboŋa tokkoanɛɛ ni anɛɛ ani kalfaahoro ni tokkoahoro, 42,360. 67Di kaa kpa ba balaa la n ɛɛ baala ni haana faa du kagboŋa aniidaanɛɛ ani kalfaahoro ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni aniidaanɛɛ, 7,337. Ba baala ni haana la n ɛɛ ba yiryitta ge faa du kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni banue, 245. 68Zagra faa du kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni anumbɛl, 736, zagra ni kauzi biizi ge faa du kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anue, 245. 69Ba nyugmazi du kalfaanaazu ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ ni anue, 435. Ba kauzi ge du kagboŋa anumbɛl ani kalfaaniidaanɛɛ ni tokko, 6,720.
70Ba domeezi nabɔnzi baŋhinaa faa kɛɛwɛ di hiini, bá kpa ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hiŋ. A hɛri nabɔma faa tɛɛ saliŋ kilozi ŋmantannaazi, 8, tassazi tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, 50 ani Kɔraawiizi kizeehina bɔmbɔga kalfaanue ni tokko ni kpɔrgɔ, 530. 71Domeezi nabɔnzi ge faa tɛɛ saliŋ kilozi kalfa ni tokkoahoro ni ŋmantannaazi, 168 ni saliŋhuŋŋa kilozi kagboŋ ni kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni fi, 1,250. 72Nɛra la maa n faa kawɛɛ ge tɛɛ saliŋ kilozi kalfa ni tokkoahoro ni ŋmantannaazi, 168, saliŋhuŋŋa kilozi kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ, 140 ani Kɔraawiizi kizeehina bɔmbɔga tokkoahoro ni aniidaanɛɛ, 67.
73Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee, Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuguure, yiryitta, nɛkpila, Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna ani Izrɛl hina maa faa so Juda bola ni u bolzenaa.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 8
Content:
Ɛzra n karmi Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hɔŋ wia
1Baaguzi aniidaanɛɛhiŋ n wa helle, di Izrɛl hina maa sogo ba bola la, a nɛra maa faa wa chaali bɔkpaŋ, a koŋlii Nii Dominuuzeŋ la bɔwar la. Denii ba ŋɔ ba karchi Ɛzra be, dí u kpa Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la n du Moosis hɔŋ biini la lii baaŋ. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi faa lizi tɛɛ Izrɛl hina la.
2Denii a baaguzi aniidaanɛɛhiŋ lugli hɔpizii, Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra kpa Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg Hɔŋ la lii nɛra la maa n chaalɛɛ la be. Baalaa, haanaa ani nɛr la maa n niŋ wer zum wia zɛɛ nɛnnɛ. 3Denii u faa karmuu ba ra nuu, di lii chɔɔzimpikke ni guŋŋ di wa hel wibaŋkanchirii. U siwee faa chaŋ Nii Dominuuzeŋ labuu. A nɛra maa faa keŋŋi digna nɛnnɛ, di ra nuu Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg Hɔŋ la wia.
4Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Ɛzra la n faa ɛɛ ba karchi, jaa chi janjiga nyuu. Ba du a jannɛ dikuu a guŋ hɔpizii naa wia. U faa ra karmi a hɔnnɛ ka baala naa chi u nodig, Matitia, Sɛma, Anaaya, Yuria, Hilkia ani Maasɛya. Banla ge n faa chigɛ u nomɛɛllɛ, Pɛdaaya, Misɛl, Malkija, Hasum, Hasbadana, Zɛkaria ani Mɛsulam.
5Denii Ɛzra pilli a hɔŋ. Uŋ chigɛ jaŋ nyuu la wia, nɛra maanii faa wette nau. Uŋ ŋɔ u pilli a hɔŋ, nɛr maanii izee chi. 6Denii Ɛzra ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizizeŋ.” A nɛra maa lalli ba nonee chiŋ, ka ŋɔ, “Ami! Ami!!” Ka ba maa giŋŋi di willi jaami Kɔraawiizi.
7Levi dee, Jesua, Bani, Sɛrɛbia, Jamin, Akub, Sabɛtai, Hɔdia, Maasɛya, Kɛlita, Azaria, Jɔzabad, Hanan ani Pɛlaayaa faa bagli Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la wia tɛɛ a nɛra. 8Ba faa karmɔɔrɛ lii Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg Hɔŋ biini, di bagli a Gbɔgni maa zɛɛzi nɛnnɛ tɛɛ baa, bá zum.
9Denii Nɛhɛmia la n faa ɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma, Ɛzra la n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ, di kaa ɛɛ ba karchi ani Levi dee la n faa ra bagli a nɛra la jaa ŋɔ ba be, “Zinaa hɔpizii naa ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinaniirɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Bɛl maa gilɛɛ ka gil ú biini chɔgi, ú ra wii.” Dikuubɛɛwiai, baŋ faa ra karmi Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni Hɔŋ la, a nɛra biine chɔkkɔɔ, ba ra wii.
10Denii Nɛhɛmia jaa ŋɔ ba be, “Ií ra la gaa di iihinaa, di di diwee la iinna nyiŋŋi, di nyɔɔ siŋ la ge n par ia. Ka kpa aŋhina tɛɛ banla n waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, bá ge di. Zinaa hɔpizii naa ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinaniirɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Awia, bɛl maa gilɛɛ waa gil u biini ra chɔgi. Bɔsɔna la Kɔraawiizi n tɛɛ ia labuu ɛɛ ii fɔŋŋa.”
11Levi dee la jaa tig a nɛra bampiree, di ŋɔ, “Ií maa ɛɛ bɔɔiih, dikuubɛɛwiai, zinaa hɔpizii naa ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinaniirɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii biine chɔgi.”
12Denii a nɛra maa la ga di, di nyɔɔ, di di bahinaa nɛnnɛ, ka kpa aŋhina ge tɛɛ nɛra, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba nuu wia la maa baŋ karmɛɛ tɛɛ baa la zɛɛrɛ.
13A baagu hɔpizaa anɛɛhiŋ, domeezi nabɔnzi, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ani Levi dee maa faa la Ɛzra la n ɛɛ ba karchi be, bá ga helli gunla Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la n na bagli.
14Ba faa na a Gbɔg Hɔŋ, Kɔraawiizi n kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Moosis la biini lugɔ di Izrɛl hina waa di Pampannizi Hɔpizizeŋ la, bɛl maa ɔɔ lii u dia di gaa zuu pampanni biini, guŋŋ ba wa ɛɛ wiimaa tuŋ. 15Dí ba ɔɔ sii wii naa tɛɛ nɛra la maa n du ba bola ni Jɛrusalɛm, “Ií la giŋgimee hɛri di ga mɔnni ɔlivi daazi la baŋ duuwe ni anla n chigɛ pir biini kela, a daazi ani daazi la n dɔɔ paŋhoori nɛnnɛ kela, di kpa daa la banna yir mɛrtil, u paŋhoori sɔɔh du sum la ni kakubkpaŋkpargu daazi kela, di wa du pampannizi, gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ la.”
16Denii a nɛra lii ga mɔnni a daazi kela ba, di wa du pampannizi ba salli ni diŋŋizi, Kɔraawiizi Dia diŋŋizi, bɔwar la n dugli Nii Dominuuzeŋ ani unla n dugli Ɛfram Dominuuzeŋ la biine.
17Banla maa baŋ faa laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi la n bittɛ ba bol la, du pampannizi di zuu a biine. Di haŋ lii Nun biibaal Josua de dui saŋa guŋŋ di wa hel a guŋ hɔpizii hiŋ, Izrɛl hina waa kaa ɛɛ a keŋ wii naa maa, di a hɔl naa lɛi. A hɔl hiŋ, ba bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge maa.
18Di haŋ lii a hɔpizizenaa faaraa hɔl di ga hel u tuna, hɔpizi biimaanii Ɛzra ɔɔ faa karmi Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg Hɔŋ la yeŋ. Denii ba faa di a hɔpizizenaa naa hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛ. Hɔpizaa ŋmantannaazihiŋ la, ba maa chaali, gunla a Gbɔg Hɔŋ n baglɛɛ la.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 9
Content:
Izrɛl hina n sɛɛ chɔgri dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia
1A baagu himmaa hɔpizaa tokko ni anaazuhiŋ hɔl, Izrɛl hina maa chaali di vɔɔ nua, ka laali gbɔglɔŋ laala, di ɛɛ hɛɛhraa waari ba nyuuni. 2Banla maa n ɛɛ Izrɛl dee la faa bargi bahinaarɛ lii hɔɔhra maa be. Denii ba chi de di sɛɛ chɔgri, dikuu ba ni ba naabaala maa wichɔgaa wia. 3Gunnɛ ba kaa chi de himmaa di karmi Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la Gbɔg Hɔŋ la, karfizi ahoro a hɔl hiŋ, di kaa kpa karfizi ahoro di sɛɛ chɔgri, dikuu ba wichɔgaa maa wia, ka jaami Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la.
4Ba faa kuari chignibɔttɛ de izi chiŋ alugɔ bimbinni. Levi dee naabuu faa chigɛ de, Jesua, Bani, Kadmiɛl, Sɛbania, Buni, Sɛrɛbia, Bani ani Kɛnani. Baabuu faa gbooli Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la werge maa. 5Ka Levi dee naa, Jesua, Kadmiɛl, Bani, Hasabnɛya, Sɛrɛbia, Hɔdia, Sɛbania ani Pɛtahia faa chi a chignibɔr hiŋ, ka ŋɔ,
“Ií izi chi di chɔli Kɔraawiizi la
iinna hum la.
Ií ra chɔluu saŋaa saŋa maa!
Ií gil nɛr maa ra chɔli u sɔŋ la
n dɔɔ girme werge la,
haali u girme n kaali
newee chɔlaa gba.
6I bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.
Hinuu ta chinchiŋ,
chinchiŋwilaa, hɛri maa
ani kuna la maa n du u biine,
muuzenaa ni kuna la maa
n du a biine.
Hinuu tɛɛ kummaa miibɔɔ, u du de.
Kuna la maa
n du chinchiŋ ra jaamiibuu.
7Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la n lizi Abram
lii bol la banna yir Ur la
n du Babilɔn hɛri,
di bir dau u sɔŋ Abraham.
8I nawɔɔrɛ lugɔ u wia dɔɔ wibiire i be,
awiarɛ i ŋɔ nua tɛu
lugɔ i daŋ gil u naanna wa dɔɔ
Keenan, Hitti,
Amɔri, Pɛriz, Jɛbus
ani Girgas hina maa hɛri.
I gillɔɔ i wiŋɔzi hiŋ ɛɛ wibii,
dikuu i wia n dɔɔ wibii wia.
9I faa na gunla yaa naabaala
n na di dɔgnyaa Ijip hɛri,
di kaa nuu ba wile lɔi,
di lii Muuzeŋaahmu la nua.
10Baŋ faa ra di tɔɔrɔɔ Ijip hɛri la,
i faa ɛɛ wizenaa
ni nuukpuuri wiarɛ
di gil Ijip koori,
u nabɔnzi ani nɛra la maa
n du u hɛri la di dɔgnya,
dikuubɛɛwiai, i nawɔɔrɛ gunla
Ijip hina n faa ra sunni
yaa naabaala barabara ni.
I faa na sɔnnɛ tɛɛ i hiŋ
di wa lii ni zinaa.
11I faa gillɔɔ a muuzeŋ bargi bɔra anɛɛ,
ka ba ga de
di vol bɔhilii gi.
Ka ba dɔma la n faa ra duŋŋi ba luge,
bá lauri baa la waa,
i faa gillɔɔ ba ɛɛ lugɔ bia,
a muuzeŋ di ba maa.
12Hɔpizaa, i ɔɔ faa kpa baama la
n du miriti lugɔ venne
di tɔ ba see,
hamuŋa ge i kpa niŋ
n lugɔ vem, di tɔ ba see,
u ra chaani baa, ba ra vol.
13I faa lii chinne
tuu Bizeŋ Sinaai,
di ŋɔ wia ɛɛ baa.
Di tɛɛ baa i Gbɔg
ni i widaulaa la
n wesse werge.
14I ŋɔ ba gil i Heezaa Hɔpizii la ɛɛ naniinanii,
di ga i balii Moosis be,
di kpa i widaulaa
ni i Gbɔgni la tɛɛ baa.
15Lɔzi n waa kpu baa,
i tɛɛ baabuu paanuu
lii chiŋ.
Niinyɔgzi ge n waa kpu baa,
i tɛɛ baabuu nii lii bizeŋ ni.
Denii i kaa ŋɔ ba be lugɔ
bá la ga foozi hɛri la
hiŋ ŋɔ nua
lugɔ i daŋ tɛɛ baa la.
16Ka yaa naabaala kpoŋaa ni ba dignikpega wia,
ba faa waa i widaulaa hiŋŋɛ.
17Ba faa waa sɛɛwɛ ba nuu i be,
ba faa waa kaa liizi
i wizenaa la
hiŋ ɛɛwɛ ba be la wia.
Ba faa diibuu mmɔri,
di ta jina, di lizi ba nabɔma,
di ŋɔ ba daŋ kaa
bir la Ijip hɛri.
Ka hiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na suŋ nɛra ni wia,
i faa gil ba wichɔgaarɛ
ra tɛɛ baa.
Hiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi di ra gil nɛra wichɔgaa
di ra tɛɛ baa,
i nɛsunaa ni i nɛnɔŋŋaa wia,
i baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ,
awia, haa baa gillɛ ta.
18Ba faa kuari vugrɛ u ɛɛ lugɔ nabii,
di ŋɔ, ‘Vug la n lɛɛ yaa
lii Ijip hɛri labuu keŋ!’
Na gunla baŋ chagzii mag!
19Dikuu i nɛsunaa werge wia,
haa baa vɛɛwɛ ta
hɛribɔduma la biini.
Hɔpizii maa, baama la n du miriti lugɔ vem
ɔɔ faa tɔ ba seere,
di ra vol ba ra hiŋuu,
u ra bagli baa ŋmɛnɛɛ.
Waa ba siwee leuwe maa.
Hamuŋa ge ni,
gunnɛ ninlau ɔɔ baŋ ba see,
di ra vol, ba ra hiŋuu,
u ra chaani baa,
ŋmɛnɛɛ la ban niŋ ga.
Waa ba siwee leuwe maa.
20I faa kpa i Duma la n wessene,
tɛɛ baa u ra bagli baa.
Haa baa kpollee paanuu la n lii chiŋ,
ba ra yiraa maana la.
Di niinyɔgzi wa lau baa,
i ɔɔ tɛɛ baabuu nii ba nyɔɔ.
21Binni tokkoanɛɛ biini,
i kpogli baabuu nɛnnɛ hɛribɔduma biini,
di faa tɛɛ baa
kunla maa n dɛkkɛ,
Ba laalaa waa kɔzɛɛ maa,
ba naazi ge waa ɔrgɛɛ.
22I faa kpa hɛssi ni a kossii du ba nonee,
haali di tɛɛ baa hɛhjaŋa gba.
Ba lɔ Hɛsbɔn Koori Sihɔn laal,
di kpegluu, di lɛɛ u hɛri.
Gunnɛ i kaa tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa,
ba lɔ Basan Koori Ɔɔg,
di kpegli u ni u nɛra
di lɛɛ ba hɛri.
23I gil ba lul biibaala di du kpil alugɔ
chinchiŋwilaa n du chiŋ.
I kpogli baabuu di la ba ni hɛri la
hiŋ ŋɔ nua
tɛɛ ba mɛɛwaa lugɔ
baabuu niŋ ŋmɛnɛ dɔɔu la.
24Ba biibaala la,
di ga lɛɛ a hɛri u birgi ba hor.
I tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa ba dɔma ni,
ba kpegli Keenan hina la
n faa du a hɛri la.
I kpa Keenan hina, ba koora ani nɛra la
n du a hɛri la
du ba nonee,
ba ɛɛ baa gunla maa
n par baa.
25I kaa tɛɛ i nɛra Izrɛl hina hiŋ fɔŋŋa,
ba lɔ bolzeŋkpega nɛra laal,
di kpegli baa, di lɛɛ ba hɛssi
ni ba hɛrsuma maa.
Di lɛɛ ba diini la
n su kunnanaa di dɔɔ.
Ba kɔlɔnzi baŋ kiwee
ni ba grepu daazi kooni.
Ɔlivi daazi kɔrni ani daanɔnnanaakpila
maanii i nɛra Izrɛl hina lɛɛ
a birgi ba hora.
Ba ɔɔ di kuna la n par baa
di piŋ, di vuh nɛnnɛ.
Ba di bahinaa nɛnnɛ,
dikuu hiŋ kissi baa werge wia.
26Ka baŋ faa kpoŋŋe di dɔɔ dignikpega wia,
ba dii mmɔri,
di bir har kpu i Gbɔg.
Di kpu i dɔgtɛɛzi la n na karfi baa,
di ra bagli baa wia,
bá bir di ra hiŋii la.
Ba ɛɛ wichɔgaa di zuu i ni,
di chagzii werge maa.
27Denii i kpa baa tɛɛ ba dɔma,
ba dɔma hiŋ sunni baa.
Ba dɔma hiŋ n waa sunni baa la,
ba bir lɔ wile tɛi.
I lii chiŋ nuu ba wile,
dikuu i nɛsunaa werge wia,
di tɛɛ baa lɛɛra, ba lɛɛ baa
lii ba dɔma nonee biine.
28Ka baŋ wa na ba hiŋ tuŋ,
ba kaa bir ɛɛ wichɔgaa
di zuu i ni.
I kaa kpa baa du ba dɔma nonee,
ba dɔma hiŋ
di kora ba ni.
Denii ba kaa wii tɛi,
i kaa nuu ba wiraa
lii chiŋ.
Dikuu i nɛsunaa wia,
i ɔɔ faa lɛɛ baabuu
saŋa kpila maa.
29I karfi baa siaahmu ni lugɔ
bá ra hiŋ i Gbɔg, ka ba vɛɛ.
Ka kpogli dignikpega di vɛɛ i Gbɔg la
n niŋ tɛɛ newee miibɔɔ,
di u ra hiŋuu la.
Ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ di chɔgi i kiizi,
di bir ba har kpui,
di vɛɛ nuui.
30I faa di baabuu kanyitti,
biŋkpila maa biine.
I gillɔɔ i dɔgtɛɛzi ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa,
i Duma la fɔŋŋa biini,
ka ba vɛɛ nuui.
Denii i kpa baa du hɛrdumazi hina la
n bar baa la nonee biine.
31Ka dikuu i nɛsunaa wia,
haa baa vɛɛwɛ ta
gɛɛ haa gillɛ
ba wia tuŋ durnya biini.
I ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na suŋ nɛra ninɛɛ,
di ra na ba sinyɛna!
32Filaŋkennaa, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum,
unla n dɔɔ girme
di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,
i wia dɔɔ ɔnsii werge,
i ra hiŋ nɔŋŋaa nuukpaŋ la.
Tɔɔrɔɔ naa n chol yaa ni yaa koora,
sitɔɔra, i kizeehina,
i huŋhunna,
yaa naabaala
ani i nɛra maa,
di lii Asiiria koora kora dii saŋa maa
guŋŋ di wa lii zinaa,
gilɛɛ gil a ɛɛ wijigzi i be.
33Annii maa n huuzi yaa naa biini,
ka i wia dɔɔ wibiire,
i ɛɛ wii la n deŋlee,
ka yaa waa ɛɛ wichɔgaa.
34Yaa naabaala, yaa koora,
yaa sitɔɔra ani i kizeehina
vɛɛ i Gbɔg hiŋaarɛ.
Ba waa i wiŋɔɔlaa
ni i karfaazi hiŋŋɛ.
35Haali baŋ faa soge ba himmaa hɛri gba,
i kissi baabuu,
di tɛɛ baa daama ni hɛrsum.
Ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi
gɛɛ di ra humii.
36Nau, yaa birgi yomaa zinaa,
hɛri la hiŋ tɛɛ
yaa naabaala la biini,
bá ra di u daazi nɔna
ani kunnanaa la maa
n niŋ lii u biini.
37Dikuu yaa wichɔgaa ɛɛi wia,
pattikuna werge la maa
n ɔɔ lii de,
ɛɛ koora la hiŋ tɛɛ
yaa la horaa.
Ba ra di koraa yaa ni yaa sela maa ni,
gunla maa n par baa.
Yaa biine chɔkkɔɔ
werge maa!”
A nɛra n ɛɛ nuukpaŋ wia
38“Dikuu annii maa wia, yaa ra ɛɛ nuukpannɛ, di sɛbuu ra dau, di gil yaa sitɔɔra, Levi dee ani Kɔraawiizi kizeehina kpa ba nonee jaguu.”

Title: NƐHƐMIA 10
Content:
1Nɛra la n faa jag ba noneere keŋ,
Hakalia biibaal Nɛhɛmia la n faa ɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma,
Zɛdɛkia, 2Sɛraaya, Azaria, Jɛrɛmia,
3Pasur, Amaria Malkija,
4Hatus, Sɛbania, Maluk,
5Harim, Mɛrɛmɔf, Obadia,
6Daniɛl, Ginɛtɔn, Baruk,
7Mɛsulam, Abija, Mijamin,
8Maazia, Bilgai ani Sɛmaaya.
Bannii maa faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehinaa.
9Levi dee genii keŋ,
Azania biibaal Jesua, Binui n lii Hɛnadad biibaala biini, Kadmiɛl
10ni ba lulla, Sɛbania,
Hɔdia, Kɛlita, Pɛlaaya, Hanan,
11Mika, Rɛhɔb, Hasabia,
12Zakur, Sɛrɛbia, Sɛbania,
13Hɔdia, Bani ani Bɛninu.
14A nɛra sitɔɔra,
Parɔs, Pahaf Moab, Ɛlam, Zatu, Bani,
15Buni, Azgad, Bɛbai,
16Adonija, Bigvai, Adin,
17Ata, Hɛzɛkia, Azur,
18Hɔdia, Hasum, Bɛzai,
19Harif, Anatɔf, Nɛbai,
20Magpias, Mɛsulam, Hɛzir,
21Mɛsɛzabɛl, Zadɔk, Jadua,
22Pɛlatia, Hanan, Anaaya,
23Hosia, Hanania, Hasub,
24Halɔhɛs, Pilha, Sobek,
25Rɛhum, Hasabna, Maasɛya,
26Ahia, Hanan, Anan,
27Maluk, Harim ani Baana.
28“Banla maa n kawɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee, dominuuguure, yiryitta, Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna ani nɛra la maa n bargi bahinaa lii hɛssi hina la n soge bar baa la biini, dikuu Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg wia, ba haana ani ba biizi la maa n binnɛ lugɔ ba daŋ wer zum wia zɛɛ 29ni ba nabɔnzenaa maa jaa hɛɛhzi, di ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be lugɔ ba daŋ hiŋ u Gbɔg la, u widaulaa, u baglaazi ani u kiizi la uŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ u balii Moosis la. Di ba waa guŋ wa ɛɛwɛ, nuuseei di baa.
30Yaa ŋɔ nuarɛ lugɔ yaa ni yaa biibaala wàá ka kpa nɛdumazi biihaana, yaa ge biihaana wàá ka yuu hɛrdumazi hina la n bar yaa la.
31Di hɛrdumazi hina wa kpa ba kooliŋkuna gɛɛ ba kunyoolaa di ba yaa bol, bá wa yoo Heezaa Hɔpizii gɛɛ hɔpizinaiinanii maa, yaa wàá yawaa. Binni aniidaanɛɛhiŋ waa maa biini, yaa wàá par. Kima la maa nɛra n di yaa ge, yaa daŋ gilaa tɛɛ baa.
32Bina maa, yaa bɛl maa daŋ ɔɔ kɛɛ saliŋhuŋŋu kebisaujiga, bá kpa hiini turgi Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna. 33Paanuu la baŋ ɔɔ kpa dau tɛɛbul ni la, hɔpizi biimaa mbusu lizaa mia, hɔpizi biimaa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa, Heezaa Hɔpizii mbusuzi lizaa kuna, Baagufalii Hɔpizizenaa ani hɔpizizenaa aŋhina, mbusunanaa aŋhina, Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa giltɛɛi mbusuzi lizaa ani kuna la maa ban niŋ kpa di ra hum Kɔraawiizi Dia huma maa, yaabuu dɔɔ a maa kɛɛi.
34Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee ani nɛra la maa n kawɛɛ daŋ ɔɔ ta kuna bina maa, di na dee la n niŋ ɔɔ ba daahilaa ni, bá ɔɔ kpa di fuuh kuna Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la mbusu lizibɔr la ni, di tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ u Gbɔg Hɔŋ biini la.
35Bina maa, yaa daŋ ɔɔ kpa yaa lugli pattikuna ani daazi lugli nɔna maa, ba i Dia.
36Di kaa lii gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ i Gbɔg Hɔŋ biini la, yaa bɛl maa daŋ ɔɔ kpa u biibambilugli, u nauna, peeza ani buuna hora, di wa tɛɛ i kizeehina la n na hum i Dia la.
37Di kaa jaa annii maa ni, yaa daŋ ɔɔ kpa yaa kooni lugli mia sau, yaa daazi lugli nɔna, lugli siŋ ani nuu wa tɛɛ i kizeehina, i Dia biini. Yaa daŋ ɔɔ kpa yaa pattikuna fizi bɔkpaŋkpaŋa tɛɛ Levi dee la, di lii bola la maa biine yaa n na par la, dikuubɛɛwiai, baabuu ɔɔ ra lɛɛa. 38I kizeehina la n lii Aarɔn naanna biini labuu ɔɔ ra hiŋ a Levi dee, ba ra lɛɛ a kuna fi maa bɔkpaŋ. Di ba wa lɛɛa tuŋ, bá ɔɔ kpa a fi bɔkpaŋ ga du i Dia kuna dauribɔr. 39Izrɛl hina ni Levi dee daŋ ɔɔ lizi mia, sinfalii ani ɔlivi nuu, bá kpa du i Dia kuna dauribɔr biini. Denii i kizeehina, dominuuzenaa guure ani yiryitta maa du.
Yaa wàá vɛɛ i Dia ta maa.”

Title: NƐHƐMIA 11
Content:
Nɛra la n soge Jɛrusalɛm biini wia
1A nɛra sitɔɔra ni domeezi faa so Jɛrusalɛm biini. Banla maa ge n kawɛɛ la, ba ta kunaa di lizi domeekpaŋ lii domeezi fi maa biine, ba so bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm la n ɛɛ naniinanii la biini. Ka banla maa n jaa ka la, jaa ga so ba himmaa bola. 2Denii a nɛra jaa chɔli banla maa n lizi bahinaa ŋɔ ba daŋ la ga so Jɛrusalɛm biini la.
3Denii Izrɛl hina baŋhina, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Levi dee, Kɔraawiizi Dia huŋhunna ani Solomɔn balaa naanna faa so ba himmaa hɛssi, Juda bola biine. Juda hɛri sitɔɔra la n faa soge Jɛrusalɛm biini la sɔnaa keŋ, 4Juda naanna, Uzzia biibaal Ataaya, u naabaalaa faa Zɛkaria, Amaria, Sɛfatia ani Mahalalɛl n lii Pɛrɛz domee biini. 5Di kaa kpa Baruk biibaal Maasɛya, u naabaalaa faa Kol Hɔzɛ, Hazaaya, Adaaya, Jɔyarib ani Zɛkaria n faa ɛɛ Sɛla naana. 6Pɛrɛz naanna la n soge Jɛrusalɛm biini faa du baala la n ɛɛ nɛkpega kalfaanaazu ni tokkoahoro ni ŋmantannaazi, 468.
7Bɛnjamin naanna,
Sallu, u mɛɛrɛ Mɛsulam, u naabaala genii Jɔɛd, Pɛdaaya, Kɔlaaya, Maasɛya, Itiɛl, Jɛsaaya, 8u lullaa faa Gabai ni Salai. A Bɛnjamin dee la maa n faa soge Jɛrusalɛm biini la faa du kalfa kabɛl ni tokko ni ŋmantannaazi, 928. 9Zikri biibaal Jowɛllɛ faa ba sitɔɔri, Hasɛnua biibaal Juda ge faa ra hiŋ ba hɛri karchizi nabɔma ni a bolzeŋ biini.
10Kɔraawiizi kizeehina,
Jɔyarib biibaal Jɛdaaya ni Jakin. 11Hilkia biibaal Sɛraaya. U naabaalaa faa Mɛsulam, Zadɔk, Mɛrayɔf ani Ahitub n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma. 12Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la maa n faa ra hum Kɔraawiizi Dia huma la du baala kalfa ŋmantannaazi ni tokko ni anɛɛ, 822. Adaaya, u mɛɛrɛ Jeroham, u naabaal ɛɛ Pɛlalaaya. U naabaala baŋhinaa faa Amzi, Zɛkaria, Pasur ani Malkija 13U ge ni u lulla maa faa du kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anɛɛ, 242. Ba maa ɛɛ ba domeezi nabɔnzi. Amassai, u mɛɛrɛ Azarɛl, u naabaal ɛɛ Azai. U naabaala baŋhinaa faa Mɛsilɛmɔf ani Ima. 14Ba ge maa faa ɛɛ nɛkpega kalfa ni tokko ni ŋmantannaazi, 128. Ba karchizi nabɔmaa faa Hagɛdɔlim biibaal Zabdiɛl.
15Levi dee,
Sɛmaaya, u mɛɛrɛ faa Hasub, u naabaal ge ɛɛ Azrikam. U naabaala baŋhinaa faa Hasabia ani Buni. 16Sabɛtai ni Jɔzabad n faa ɛɛ a Levi dee sitɔɔra baŋhinaa faa ra binni Kɔraawiizi Dia baŋgia huma ni. 17Maatania, u mɛɛ faa ɛɛ Mika, u naabaal ge faa ɛɛ Zabdi. Zabdi ge mɛɛ faa ɛɛ Asaf. Asaf naabuu faa ɛɛ yiryitta ni wiisuŋŋaa sitɔɔri. Bakbukia genii faa ra hiini Matania. Abda, u mɛɛrɛ faa Samua, u naabaalaa faa Galal ani Jɛdutun. 18Levi dee la maa n du bolzennaniinanii Jɛrusalɛm biini faa du kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoanaazu ni anaazu, 284.
19Dominuuguure genii faa,
Akub, Talmɔn ani ba lullaa. Ba faa du baala kalfa ni tokkoahoro ni fidaanɛɛ, 172.
20Izrɛl dizi maa n kawɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la faa jaa so ba naabaala hɛssi, Juda bolzenaa ani boljigzi maa biine.
21Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa faa so Ɔfɛl giŋgimii nyuu. Ziha ni Gispa faa ra binni ba ni.
22Levi dee nabɔma n faa du Jɛrusalɛmnɛ Bani biibaal Uzzi, u naabaallɛ faa Hasabia. U naabaalaa faa kaa ɛɛ Matania ni Mika ge. Uzi faa ɛɛ Asaf naanna la bɛl n faa ra yir yira Kɔraawiizi Dia biini, jaamaa saŋa. 23Koorii faa dɔɔ a yiryitta fɔŋŋa, di gil ba ra lɛɛ dɔŋa, ba hɔpizii maa wiɛɛlaa biini.
24Mɛsɛzabɛl biibaal Pɛtahia, n lii Zɛra domee biini di ɛɛ Juda dee hinuurɛ faa chigɛ Izrɛl hina naa Pɛsia hina seriya diiribɔr.
25A nɛra kpilakpila faa sogo bola la n dugli ba koonii. Banla n faa lii Juda dee biini faa so Kiriaf Aaba, Dibɔn, Jɛkabziil ani boljigzi la n dugli bolzenaa naa. 26Baŋhina faa so bolzenaa naa, Jesua, Mɔlada, Bɛf Pɛlɛt, 27Hazar Sual, bolzeŋ Bɛɛsiba ani boljigzi la n baruu la. 28Baŋhina faa so Ziklag, Mɛkɔna ani boljigzi la n baruu. 29Baŋhina so Ɛn Rimɔn, Zɔra, Jamuf, 30Zanoa, Adulam ani boljigzi la n baraa. Ba faa so Lakis di dugli ba kooni, di kaa so Azɛka ni u boljigzi. Ba faa sogo Bɛɛsibaa guŋŋ di ga hel Hinɔm Waluu.
31Bɛnjamin dee la faa so Gɛba, Mikmas, Aija, Bɛtɛl ani boljigzi la n duglaa 32ni Anatɔf, Nɔb, Anania, 33Hazɔr, Rama, Gitam, 34Hadid, Zɛbɔyim, Nɛbalat, 35Lɔɔd, Ono ani Banla N Zum Nonee Huma hina Waluu biini.
36Levi dee la sugezi aŋhina n lii Juda ge faa so Bɛnjamin.

Title: NƐHƐMIA 12
Content:
Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee wia
1Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la, Sɛɛltiɛl biibaal Zɛrubabɛl ani Jesua n bittɛ ba la sɔnaa keŋ,
Sɛraaya Jɛrɛmia, Ɛzra,
2Amaria, Maluk, Hatus,
3Sɛkania, Rɛhum, Mɛrɛmɔf,
4Ido, Ginɛtɔn, Abija,
5Mijamin, Moadia, Bilga,
6Sɛmaaya, Jɔyarib, Jɛdaaya,
7Sallu, Amɔk, Hilkia ani Jɛdaaya.
Baabuu faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Nabɔnzi, Jesua saŋa la.
8Levi dee la n faa du de a saŋa la sɔnaa keŋ, Jesua, Binui, Kadmiɛl, Sɛrɛbia, Juda ani Matania ni u har hina la n faa ra yir Kɔraawiizi Dia yira la. 9Bakbukia, Uni ani ba balaa ge ɔɔ chi chaŋ baa, di ra sɛɛ a yira.
10Jesua biibaallɛ Jɔyakim, Jɔyakim ge biibaallɛ Ɛliasib, Ɛliasib ge biibaallɛ Jɔyada. 11Jɔyada ge biibaal ɛɛ Jonatan, Jonatan biibaal ɛɛ Jadua.
12Saŋa la Jɔyakim n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma la, nɛra la n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina domeezi nabɔnzi sɔnaa keŋ,
Sɛraaya domee sitɔɔrii faa Mɛraaya,
Jɛrɛmia domee sitɔɔrii faa Hanania,
13Ɛzra domee sitɔɔrii faa Mɛsulam,
Amaria domee sitɔɔrii faa Jɛhɔhanan,
14Maluk domee sitɔɔrii faa Jonatan,
Sɛkania domee sitɔɔrii faa Joosɛf,
15Harim domee sitɔɔrii faa Adna,
Mɛrɛmɔf domee sitɔɔrii faa Hɛlkai,
16Ido domee sitɔɔrii faa Zɛkaria,
Ginɛtɔn domee sitɔɔrii faa Mɛsulam,
17Abija domee sitɔɔrii faa Zikri.
Miniamin ni Moadia domee sitɔɔrii faa Piltai,
18Bilga domee sitɔɔrii faa Samua,
Sɛmaaya domee sitɔɔrii faa Jɛhɔnatan,
19Jɔyarib domee sitɔɔrii faa Matɛnai,
Jɛdaaya domee sitɔɔrii faa Uzi,
20Sallu domee sitɔɔrii Kalai,
Amɔk domee sitɔɔrii Ɛba,
21Hilkia domee hor ɛɛ Hasabia,
Jɛdaaya domee hor faa ɛɛ Nɛtanɛl.
22Ba faa sɛbi Levi dee ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehina domeezi nabɔnzi sɔnaa dau, di lii Ɛliasib, Jɔyada, Jɔhanan ani Jadua nabɔmuu dii saŋazi. Pɛsia Koorizeŋ Dariɔs kora dii saŋaa ba faa sɛbaa tuŋ. 23Ba faa sɛbi domeezi nabɔnzi sɔnaa lii Levi naanna biini guŋŋ di ga hel Ɛliasib biibaal Jɔhanan saŋa, di du ba Faala Hɔŋ biini. 24Levi dee la sitɔɔraa faa Hasabia, Sɛrɛbia, Kadmiɛl biibaal Jesua ani banla n ɔɔ faa chi chaŋ baa, ka ba ra jaami Kɔraawiizi di ra chɔluu la. Keŋkere bɛl hina sɛɛ di ra du a keŋkere bɛl hina gunla Kɔraawiizi balii Koori Deevid n faa sɛbɛɛ du hɔŋ biini la.
25Matania, Bakbukia, Obadia, Mɛsulam, Talmɔn ani Akubrɛ faa ra guu diibizi la banna dau kuna la n dugli dominuuzenaa la. 26Ba faa hum ba humaa Jesua biibaal Jɔyakim naabaal n ɛɛ Jɔzadak, Nɛhɛmia n faa ɛɛ a hɛri nabɔma ani Ɛzra n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ ni karchi de dui saŋazi.
Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii kpai du Kɔraawiizi nonee wia
27Baŋ wa ma Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii la tuŋ di ŋɔ ba kpau du Kɔraawiizi nonee, ba faa gillɔɔ Levi dee lii bɔra la maa baŋ duwɛɛ la ba Jɛrusalɛm, di wa di a guŋ hɔpizii hiŋ, di yir yira, di lɔ danyɛ pɛrɛtuzi, kemzi ani janjalanzi, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ ni bɔsɔna. 28A yiryitta maa faa lii bola la n bar Jɛrusalɛm ni boljigzi la n bar Nɛtɔfafuu. 29Baŋhina faa lii Bɛf Gilgal, Gɛba ani Azmavɛf bariirɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, a yiryitta faa ma ba bolaa bar Jɛrusalɛm. 30Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Levi dee la n wa sɔ bahinaa di lizi ba doŋa ha, ka ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa la, ba jaa ɛɛ a nɛra, a koŋlii dominuuzenaa ani a koŋlii ge maa guŋ.
31Annii maa n wa tunnɛ, denii n gil Juda hina nabɔnzi tinni a koŋlii nyuu, ka n gil yiryitta sugezenaa anɛɛ jaa ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ. A suge bɛl ge tinni a koŋlii nodig keŋkere, di ra la Hul Dominuuzeŋ la. 32Hɔsaaya ni Juda nabɔnzi yeŋ hiŋ ba ni. 33Kenne ba faa hiŋ dɔŋa ni, Azaria, Ɛzra, Mɛsulam, 34Juda, Bɛnjamin, Sɛmaaya, Jɛrɛmia 35ani Kɔraawiizi kizeehina baŋhina ge, ba ra huuh bensunozi, di kaa kpa Jonatan biibaal Zɛkaria. U naabaalaa faa Sɛmaaya, Matania, Mikaaya, Zakur n lii Asaf domee biini 36ani u ni u domee nɛra baŋhina, baabuu, Sɛmaaya, Azarɛl, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nɛtanɛl, Juda ani Hanani. Ba maanii faa kpogli kunlɔɔlaa la Kɔraawiizi balii Koori Deevid n baglɛɛ la. Karchi Ɛzraa faa tɔ ba see, 37di lii a koŋlii Bule Dominuuzeŋ la, ba faa chi ta chɔŋ guŋŋ di ga tinni Koori Deevid Bolzeŋ lɔŋa la baŋ ɔɔ ga tinni Koori Deevid sal, di ga hel Nii Dominuuzeŋ la n du wiifurii la.
38A yiryitta suge bɛl ge ta chɔŋ di ga keŋkere bɛl. N ni a nɛra yeŋ faa ra hiŋ ba ni, a koŋlii nyuu guŋŋ di ga bɛri Paanuu Ɔɔzibɔr Diijaŋ la, di ga hel a Koŋlii War la, 39di ga de gilli la Ɛfram Dominuuzeŋ, di kpa la Jɛsana Dominuuzeŋ, di lii de la Nyinni Dominuuzeŋ, di kaa lii de la Hananɛl Diijaŋ ani Kalfa Diijaŋ la, di chi de la Peeza Dominuuzeŋ la. Baŋ ga hel Guuri Dominuuzeŋ la, ba chi de.
40A yiryitta suge anɛɛ la n kpa jaaŋ di tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la, jaa zuu so ba sognibɔra, Kɔraawiizi Dia biini. Denii n ge ni nabɔnzi la yeŋ, 41di kpa Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, baabuu, Ɛliakim, Maasɛya, Miniamin, Mikaaya, Ɛliɔnai, Zɛkaria ani Hanania, n kpogli bensunozi. 42Banniibuu ge kaa hiŋ di zuu, Maasɛya, Sɛmaaya, Ɛliaza, Uzi, Jɛhɔhanan, Malkija, Ɛlam ani Ɛza. Denii Jɛzrahia jaa tɔ a yiryitta see, ba ra yir yira. 43A hɔl hiŋ, ba lizi mbusuzii werge maa Kɔraawiizi be ni bampirsɔna, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n tɛɛ baa bɔsɔna werge maa wia. Gunnɛ haana ni bichalli ge gba bɔra faa sɔɔni, ba ra kɔɔ werge. Awia, a kɔɔi faa lii Jɛrusalɛm biini di la bɔɔnɛɛ werge maa.
